title: Remote Operations VA - US Car Rental (Phone, GoHighLevel, Clear English a MUST)
description:
About us:

Odel Rentals is a U.S.-based car rental company in Maryland. We rent cars to gig drivers (Uber, DoorDash, Instacart, Amazon Flex) and to direct renters. We run on GoHighLevel (GHL) and we use an AI assistant to help run the business. We are a small, fast-moving team that values clear communication, discipline, and real ownership. Do great work here and you grow with us.



What you will do:

You are the main person talking to our U.S. renters and keeping the operation organized. This is a phone-first job. You must be comfortable calling people, sounding warm and professional, and helping renters on the phone.

- Call new leads fast, answer inbound calls, explain our service, and qualify renters.

- Collect and review renter documents (driver's license, gig-earnings screenshot, proof of residency) and spot anything fake, expired, or mismatched.

- Run background checks and judge them. Auto-fail theft, violence, or fraud history. Escalate when unsure.

- Coordinate pickups and returns. No car is released without confirmed payment AND a signed agreement.

- Help manage our AI dashboard: it writes draft messages for you to check, and you catch the bad ones before they go out.

- Keep our GoHighLevel CRM clean: work leads, move them through the pipeline, log every call and note, run follow-ups.

- Track payments, send reminders, update our fleet and revenue sheets, and store documents where they belong.



Must-haves (read carefully):

1. CLEAR, NEUTRAL SPOKEN ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. This is a phone job with U.S. customers. You must be easy for an American to understand on the first try. This is our number one requirement, no exceptions.

2. Strong written English.

3. Comfortable on the phone. You can call people and not get rattled.

4. Sharp eye for risky renters and fake documents.

5. Detail-obsessed and reliable. You log everything and follow a written process exactly.

6. CRM experience. GoHighLevel (GHL) strongly preferred. If you are strong on the phone and have used another CRM, we will train you on GHL.

7. You can reliably work U.S. Eastern daytime hours (your night) long-term.

8. Good internet, a working headset, a quiet place to take calls, and a backup for power or wifi outages.



Nice-to-haves:

- Bilingual English/Spanish (many gig drivers are Spanish-first).

- Hands-on GoHighLevel experience.

- U.S. car rental, Turo, or transportation experience.

- Spreadsheets and background-check tools (Intelius, Forewarn). Comfort with AI tools.



Hours and pay: Full-time, U.S. Eastern Time daytime, the same full hours every day, long-term. This role pays up to $5 per hour (about $500 to $866 per month), based on your experience. Only apply if that works for you. You start on a smaller set of tasks (lead response, phone calls, helping manage our AI dashboard) and take on more as you prove out.



HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly or you will be skipped):

Do NOT send a generic copy-paste reply. In your application, answer ALL of these questions in order. To prove you read this whole post, work the words "FULL TANK" into one of your answers in a full sentence (not just the words by themselves). Applications that skip the questions or leave out "FULL TANK" will not be reviewed.

1. Have you worked in a role where you handled structured processes and strict deadlines? Give an example.

2. How comfortable are you making phone calls daily with U.S. customers? About how many calls per day have you done, and what kind?

3. What experience do you have specifically with GoHighLevel (GHL)? If you have used it, describe exactly what you did in it. If not, what other CRM have you used?

4. What U.S. hours can you reliably work long-term, and can you keep a U.S. Eastern daytime schedule (your night)?

5. Where did you learn English, and can a U.S. customer easily understand you on the phone? Be honest.

6. Have you ever reviewed ID documents, run background checks, or screened customers? Describe it.

7. Scenario: a renter wants to take the car tonight but has not paid yet and has not signed the agreement. What do you do?

8. What is your expected pay (per hour or per month)? This role pays up to $5 per hour, so only apply if that works for you.



Plus a 60 to 90 second Loom or video recording where you introduce yourself in English and read this line out loud in a natural voice: "Hi, thanks for calling Odel Rentals, are you currently a gig driver and how long are you looking to rent?" Paste the link in your application. No video means we will not review it. This is how we hear your phone voice.

title: Assistant Property Manager (Yardi Voyager)
description:
**PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ATTACH/LINK YOUR RESUME AND VIDEO INTRODUCTION BEFORE APPLYING OTHERWISE YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE IGNORED**



Assistant Property Manager (Yardi Voyager) 



Job Type: Full-Time



Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM EST, with a 30-minute unpaid break



Job Overview: 



We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Assistant Property Manager (Yardi Voyager) to support the day-to-day operations of a growing property management portfolio. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in property management, strong tenant communication skills, and a solid understanding of leasing, maintenance coordination, rent collection, and delinquency management. This role requires someone who can effectively manage tenant and vendor relationships, maintain accurate records, and ensure properties operate efficiently while delivering excellent customer service.



Key Responsibilities:



Leasing & Tenant Relations

Assist with leasing activities, including responding to inquiries, scheduling property showings, and processing applications.

Coordinate lease renewals, move-ins, and move-outs.

Serve as a primary point of contact for tenants and respond to inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

Maintain positive tenant relationships and ensure a high level of customer service.



Rent Collection & Delinquency Management

Monitor rent payments and follow up on outstanding balances.

Communicate with tenants regarding late payments and payment arrangements.

Track delinquencies and maintain accurate records of collection efforts.

Assist in preparing reports related to rent collection and tenant accounts.



Maintenance Coordination

Receive, document, and coordinate maintenance requests.

Communicate directly with tenants and vendors regarding maintenance concerns and work orders.

Schedule repairs and follow up to ensure timely completion.

Track maintenance progress and maintain detailed records within the property management system.



Property Operations & Administration

Maintain accurate tenant, lease, and property records.

Assist with vendor coordination and invoice processing.

Generate reports and update property data using Yardi Voyager.

Support property managers with administrative and operational tasks as needed.

Ensure compliance with company policies and property management procedures.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

Minimum of 2 years of property management experience.

Strong experience in leasing, tenant relations, maintenance coordination, rent collection, and delinquency management.

Proficiency in Yardi Voyager.

Experience coordinating directly with tenants, vendors, and maintenance teams.

Strong understanding of property management operations and administration.

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Strong customer service and relationship management skills.

Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.

Experience managing residential and/or commercial properties is preferred.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: QA Unit & Functional Test Writer - Long-Term Opportunity
description:
== Fintech company seeks QA unit & functional test script writer ==



Must have experience with Stripe and knowledge of the legacy "charge" flow versus the modern "payment intents" and "payment method" object transaction flow.  Must have working experience with postman and writing manual unit and functional tests with steps-to-reproduce and respective inputs



NOTE: If you do not have this experience, please do not apply as you'll be unable to satisfy the requirements and payment will not be rendered.



== Background ==



We've had a legacy XML API for credit card transactions using the traditional "charge" model similar to Stripe's legacy Charges API (just post the card data with the amount to charge).  For example, 1 endpoint is called with a payload that contains a raw card number and an amount to be charged.  We have a mature unit testing spreadsheet for it.



We now have a a RESTful API which has a different workflow more closely aligned with Stripe's PaymentIntents process.   In this workflow, a PaymentIntent object is created (like an invoice) and then a second object is created for a PaymentMethod (ie. card number).  Those 2 items are connected, the card is authorized via "Confirm", and then the transaction is charged via "Capture".   This may be performed in 1 combined API call or as many as 5 API calls.  As such, there are many permutations of workflows within those 5.  This differs from the legacy method of posting all this data together in 1 request.



The RESTful API has a server-side NodeJS SDK which invokes the API.



We have a comprehensive unit testing spreadsheet for the server-side SDK along with a few RESTful endpoints but we do not have a comprehensive RESTful unit test list.  Only a few tests have been included.



The goal of this project is to create 1 comprehensive and up-dated suite of unit and functional test scripts for the RESTful API and its server-side library:  To do this:



(1) Do a gap analysis of the "Legacy" XML "charge/sale" API tests against the "New" RESTful "paymentIntents, paymentMethods, confirm/capture" API documentation (to be provided).

(1. a) Identify which tests from the Legacy list are accounted for by a parallel test in the New list.

(1.b) Identify which tests from the Legacy list do not have an equivalent in the New list and therefore must be written.



(2) Write the unit tests in the New list which accomplish filling the gaps from 1.b.  All tests must include steps to reproduce, expected results, URLs, URL parameters, headers, GET queries, and all probable permutations of POST/PUT payloads.

(2.a) In the event of 1.a,  if there is a close match which requires minor changes or additions to the input/body, either create a new test or revise the inputs/body of the matched test provided that it has no material impact on the existing test's outcome.

(2.b) Be sure to account for all probable permutations of each test flow.  For example...

Scenario1.Test1: (A) create payment intent, (B) create payment method with given test data, (C) attach payment method to payment intent, (D) confirm payment intent, (E) capture payment intent.

Scenario1.Test2: (A) create payment intent with automatic confirmation, (B) create payment method with given test data, (C) attach payment method to payment intent, (D) capture payment intent (confirmation was already performed automatically per step 1)

Scenario1.Test3: (A) create payment method (b) Create payment intent with with automatic confirmation and automatic capture and payment method ID from step A

Scenario1.Test4: (A) Create payment intent with payment_method_data property containing raw PAN and with automatic confirmation and automatic capture.

Scenario1.Test5: (A) Create payment intent with payment_method_data property containing raw PAN and with manual confirmation and manual capture, (B) confirm payment intent, (c) capture ....

etc etc etc



(3) Populate all API unit tests in a Postman collection and export it.  Verify all your tests are accurate



You will be given a spreadsheet containing lists of both the RESTful and legacy tests with API documentation on each row, test inputs on each row, codepens, API secrets, test card numbers, and a postman collection for the new RESTful API.

title: Part-Time Maintenance & Work Order Coordinator
description:
**PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ATTACH/LINK YOUR RESUME AND VIDEO INTRODUCTION BEFORE APPLYING OTHERWISE YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE IGNORED**



Part-Time Maintenance & Work Order Coordinator



Job Type: Part-Time (20 hours per week)



Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Pacific Time



Salary: $500 per month



Job Overview: 



We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Maintenance and Work Order Coordinator to support our property management team by overseeing the maintenance workflow across residential communities. In this role, you will coordinate maintenance requests from initial submission through completion, communicate with residents, schedule maintenance technicians and vendors, and ensure repairs are completed efficiently and to a high standard. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, excellent communication, and the ability to collaborate effectively with residents, vendors, and internal teams to deliver a positive maintenance experience. 



Key Responsibilities:



Work Order Management



Receive, review, prioritize, and assign maintenance work orders.

Ensure emergency maintenance requests are dispatched immediately.

Monitor work order progress from creation through completion.

Verify work orders are completed accurately with detailed notes and photographs when required.

Close work orders only after confirming repairs have been completed satisfactorily.

Maintain accurate maintenance records within the property management software.

Resident Communication



Respond promptly to resident maintenance requests.

Schedule appointments with residents and maintenance personnel.

Keep residents informed regarding repair status and expected completion times.

Follow up with residents after repairs to ensure satisfaction.

Coordinate entry notices when maintenance requires access to occupied units.

Maintenance Coordination



Schedule daily work assignments for maintenance technicians.

Coordinate preventive maintenance programs.

Assist in planning unit turns between residents.

Track recurring maintenance issues and recommend long-term solutions.

Ensure maintenance priorities align with occupancy and resident needs.

Vendor Coordination



Schedule outside contractors and service providers.

Obtain estimates and coordinate approvals when required.

Verify contractor insurance and licenses are current.

Monitor vendor performance, quality of work, and completion timelines.

Process vendor invoices and confirm completed work before payment. Maintain vendor contact lists and service contracts.



Qualifications:



Experience with multifamily apartment communities is preferred.

Knowledge of residential maintenance systems including plumbing, electrical, HVAC,

appliances, roofing, and general building maintenance.

Experience using property management software (Yardi).

Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.



Preferred Skills:



Strong customer service orientation.

Excellent problem-solving abilities.

Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Detail-oriented with strong follow-through. 

Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Professional demeanor when interacting with residents, vendors, and staff.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Male Voiceover Artist for Calm History / Sleep Channel

Job Title: Male Voiceover Artist for Calm History / Sleep Channel (Full-Time)

Type: Full-time

Salary: $400/month to start, review at 60 days

Hours: Flexible, but consistent daily recording required

About the work:

I run a YouTube channel that publishes long-form history stories designed for relaxation and sleep. Each video runs over an hour of continuous narration. The voice IS the product — people come back because it helps them relax and fall asleep. That voice is what I'm hiring for.

This is NOT energetic, upbeat, or "radio announcer" narration. No hype, no hard selling, no dramatic swings. If your samples are punchy commercial reads, this is not the role. I need calm, slow, warm, and steady — a voice people trust and want to fall asleep to.

What you'll do:



Record clear, calm narration for long-form scripts I provide (over an hour per video)

Keep a consistent slow, soothing pace and warm tone across the full runtime

Deliver clean audio with no background noise

Re-record sections when direction calls for it

Hit a reliable daily or near-daily delivery schedule



Requirements:



Clear, neutral, easy-to-understand English pronunciation

A calm, low, steady speaking voice (this is the whole job)

A quiet recording space and a decent microphone

Reliable daily availability and fast communication

Voiceover or narration experience is a strong plus



To apply:

Put the word LANTERN at the top of your application so I know you read this fully. Applications without it get deleted.

A voice sample of you reading the exact script below, recorded in your normal setup

Any other narration samples you have

Your monthly rate for full-time work

title: GHL CRM + Automation Specialist (Real Estate Experience)
description:
We’re a land acquisitions company looking for someone experienced with GoHighLevel (white label) who understands real estate workflows, Leads, and can build out a clean, simple CRM system.



Our goal is to take our previous CRM (Resimpli) and rebuild it inside GHL using pipelines, workflows, and automations.



We already have a clear vision for how we want the system to function. We need someone who can take that vision and build it out properly.



What we need:



Build and organize pipelines (Comping + Acquisitions)

Set up workflows and automations based on tags and stages

Create a simple, stage-based system (not task-heavy)

Ensure clean lead flow from leads in, to offers out, to closings

Prevent duplicate opportunities and backwards movement

Set up KPI tracking through pipeline movement



System structure:



Texter (AI-driven) qualifies and tags leads

Comper handles comping and valuation

Texter sends offers

Acquisitions calls and closes



Automation & Integration:



Experience with Zapier and/or n8n preferred

Ability to integrate external systems into GHL

Long-term goal is to automate most of the workflow end-to-end

Experience with AI or automated messaging systems is a plus



Contracts:



Set up contract automation using Zapier + DocuSign or PandaDoc

Ensure signatures include IP tracking and certification

Sync contract status back into GHL



Important:

If you DO NOT have experience building real estate CRM systems or similar workflow automations, please DO NOT apply.



Compensation & Scope:

Please include your fixed price for this project and briefly outline what deliverables you would provide.



Deliverables should include:



Fully built pipelines inside GHL

Workflows and automations based on tags and stages

Clean lead flow across Texter, Comper, and Acquisitions

Basic documentation or SOP explaining how the system works



This will start as a project (gig). If completed successfully, there is an opportunity for ongoing work and further system expansion.

Examples of similar systems you’ve built

Platforms you’ve worked with (GHL, Podio, etc.)

Any experience with automation tools (Zapier, n8n, APIs, etc.)

A lead replies “Yes” or “Interested” to a text message.



What happens next in the system from:



Tagging the lead

Moving them into a pipeline

Assigning it to a user

Getting it to the Ready for Offer stage

We’re looking for someone who understands systems and can build this cleanly, simply, and in a scalable way.

title: Dead by Daylight Gameplay Editor - Long-Form (Ongoing, 1 Video/Week)
description:
About the Role:

Hello! I run a Dead by Daylight YouTube channel and need a reliable editor to turn my raw gameplay recordings into finished long-form videos - 1 per week, ongoing. The editing itself is very simple (cuts, no effects, full tutorial provided). 



NOTE: You must play Dead By Daylight or have sufficient knowledge about the game.

Non-negotiable. Good cuts depend on understanding what's on screen. Someone who doesn't know DBD will trim the wrong things and leave in the boring ones. 

1,000+ hours strongly preferred, or clearly strong existing knowledge of the game.

You should instantly recognize the difference between a 
nt worth keeping and filler.



Example: 

(This video has only one game in it, but serves as an example of the general editing style and pacing)



What You'll Do:

- For each video you'll receive two gameplay recordings (two matches). 

- Cut out dead spots, filler, and anything that isn't interesting gameplay, commentary, or a notable event

- Keep the gameplay and commentary front and center. It's the entire point of the channel

- Combine the two matches into one clean finished video

- Level the audio and export to spec (requirements below)

- No motion graphics or effects needed. A tutorial walks through the exact workflow and export settings.



Specs (every video):

- Audio: a two-track recording is provided (mic + game audio). Level the game audio to -18 to -20 dB and the mic to -1 to -4 dB

- Export: high quality, using the render settings from the tutorial presentation matters a lot on this channel and the video may be compressed on YouTube if exported improperly

- Files may be large. Keep roughly 20 GB free for comfortable editing and rendering, and you'll need a solid connection to download raw footage and upload finished files



Workflow & Logistics:

- Volume: 1 video/week, ongoing - you will receive 4+ days before due date

- You receive: 2 raw recordings per video (each 10–20 min), sent via 
 / Google Drive

- Delivery: upload finished videos to Google Drive (or equivalent)

- Communication: everything runs through 

- Good computer/laptop recommended to comfortably edit the footage.



Compensation

- $9–$12 USD per video, paid bi-weekly via Wise.

- Paid trial: first 1–2 videos at the base rate as a fit-check (paid, never free)

- Ongoing / long-term: I need one reliable person, not a rotating cast



How to Apply:

Because game knowledge is the whole point, start your reply by naming your most-played killer or survivor, your rough hours in DBD, and your favourite perk. That tells me two things: that you read this, and that you actually play.



Then include:

- A link to your portfolio, or a few videos you've edited (Dead By Daylight videos preferred, if you have edited any)

- What software you edit in

- Your timezone, daily availability, and confirmation your internet handles large up/downloads

- Confirmation you can use 
 and get paid via Wise



No main + hours + perk = skipped. No work sample = skipped.

title: Phone Support Executive Assistant/Leasing Agent (WFH)
description:
We are looking for someone who naturally enjoys talking to people, building relationships, and being the welcoming first voice of our company.



If you view work as simply clocking in and clocking out, this role will likely not be a fit.



If you take pride in ownership, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to become an indispensable part of a growing business, keep reading.



WHO YOU ARE



-You are warm, friendly, and confident on the phone.

-You know how to make people feel comfortable within the first few moments of a conversation.

-You enjoy talking with people and helping them move forward.

-You are reliable, proactive, and take responsibility without needing constant supervision.

-You don't sound robotic, scripted, or transactional, and you usually avoid filler words such as "um."

-You understand that being the first voice someone hears can directly impact a company's success.



AVAILABILITY EXPECTATIONS



-Monday-Friday availability during business hours (U.S. Pacific Time)

-Primary phone monitoring coverage between 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM Monday-Friday (U.S. Pacific Time Zone)

-Ability to answer calls whenever reasonably available during committed working periods

-Additional responsiveness outside primary coverage hours is part of the ownership mindset required for this role



Success in this role is measured by reliability, responsiveness, caller experience, and ownership, not by sitting at a computer for a specific number of hours (and actually it's perfectly reasonable for some things like phone monitoring to be handled via your own mobile phone outside of primary availability hours).



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



-Work-from-home experience

-Night shift experience

-At least 2 years with the same employer

-Executive Assistant, Customer Service, Receptionist, Sales, Hospitality, or BPO experience

-Significant phone-based experience

-Excellent spoken English with a clear and professional speaking voice (using little to no filler words)

-Enjoy using Technology and regularly check your phone

-Prior Property Management experience is not required. We are more interested in strong communication, relationship-building, and phone skills. Our successful teammate came from a sales background.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



• You dislike talking to people

• You prefer scripted conversations

• You need constant supervision

• You are looking for a role that turns into management or a different path. (We are a small company, which means you will already be handling a wide variety of responsibilities across the business.)

• You want a clock-in/clock-out environment



ABOUT US



We are a small (5 members) U.S.-based Property Management company that values loyalty, ownership, and long-term relationships. None of us clock in or out. We view the company's success as our success and don't mind checking in frequently to make sure things are running smoothly.



We believe great team members should be appreciated, recognized, and rewarded.



Our goal is to find someone who thrives with an ownership mindset, wants stability, and desires a long-term home with our family-like company.



COMPENSATION



• Work From Home, Independent Contractor Position

• Full-Time Opportunity

• $800-1000 USD/month + bonuses paid for each property leased (up to $1000 USD additional per quarter)

• Long-term permanent position



If you genuinely enjoy talking with people, taking ownership, enjoy the feeling of being truly valued and making a difference, plus want a long term stable position, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply Here: applynow.excalbook.com



OLJ Applications or OLJ Messages will not be reviewed.

Apply Here: applynow.excalbook.com

title: Phone Support Executive Assistant/Leasing Agent (Property Management, No PM Experience Required)
description:
We are looking for someone who naturally enjoys talking to people, building relationships, and being the welcoming first voice of our company.



If you view work as simply clocking in and clocking out, this role will likely not be a fit.



If you take pride in ownership, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to become an indispensable part of a growing business, keep reading.



WHO YOU ARE



-You are warm, friendly, and confident on the phone.

-You know how to make people feel comfortable within the first few 
nts of a conversation.

-You enjoy talking with people and helping them move forward.

-You are reliable, proactive, and take responsibility without needing constant supervision.

-You don't sound robotic, scripted, or transactional, and you usually avoid filler words such as "um."

-You understand that being the first voice someone hears can directly impact a company's success.



AVAILABILITY EXPECTATIONS



-Monday-Friday availability during business hours (U.S. Pacific Time)

-Primary phone monitoring coverage between 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM Monday-Friday (U.S. Pacific Time Zone)

-Ability to answer calls whenever reasonably available during committed working periods

-Additional responsiveness outside primary coverage hours is part of the ownership mindset required for this role



Success in this role is measured by reliability, responsiveness, caller experience, and ownership, not by sitting at a computer for a specific number of hours (and actually it's perfectly reasonable for some things like phone monitoring to be handled via your own mobile phone outside of primary availability hours).



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



-Work-from-home experience

-Night shift experience

-At least 2 years with the same employer

-Executive Assistant, Customer Service, Receptionist, Sales, Hospitality, or BPO experience

-Significant phone-based experience

-Excellent spoken English with a clear and professional speaking voice (using little to no filler words)

-Enjoy using Technology and regularly check your phone

-Prior Property Management experience is not required. We are more interested in strong communication, relationship-building, and phone skills. Our successful teammate came from a sales background.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



• You dislike talking to people

• You prefer scripted conversations

• You need constant supervision

• You are looking for a role that turns into management or a different path. (We are a small company, which means you will already be handling a wide variety of responsibilities across the business.)

• You want a clock-in/clock-out environment



ABOUT US



We are a small (5 members) U.S.-based Property Management company that values loyalty, ownership, and long-term relationships. None of us clock in or out. We view the company's success as our success and don't mind checking in frequently to make sure things are running smoothly.



We believe great tea
mbers should be appreciated, recognized, and rewarded.



Our goal is to find someone who thrives with an ownership mindset, wants stability, and desires a long-term home with our family-like company.

• Work From Home, Independent Contractor Position

• Full-Time Opportunity

• $
USD/month + bonuses paid for each property leased (up to $1000 USD additional per quarter)

• Long-term permanent position



If you genuinely enjoy talking with people, taking ownership, enjoy the feeling of being truly valued and making a difference, plus want a long term stable position, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Item Setup & Catalog Specialist
description:
Company Overview

We are a Los Angeles-based wholesale fine jewelry company established in 1972, supplying gold and silver jewelry to major national retailers, warehouse clubs, military exchanges, and leading e-commerce marketplaces. The company is building a lean, systems-driven operations team where accurate product data is treated as a competitive advantage.

 

Position Summary

We are looking for an experienced Item Setup & Catalog Specialist to own the complete lifecycle of product master data and retailer item onboarding.

This role is responsible for creating accurate product records in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, coordinating cross-functional teams to gather product assets, managing retailer portal uploads, maintaining retailer requirements documentation, and ensuring product data remains accurate throughout its lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, process-driven, and capable of managing multiple product launches while maintaining exceptional data accuracy.

 

Key Responsibilities

Product Master Data Management

• Create and maintain new product records in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

• Ensure every item contains complete and accurate information before retailer submission, including:

o Vendor cost

o Cost of goods

o Metal type and fineness

o Product weight

o Dimensions

o UPC/GTIN

o Product hierarchy

• Maintain the ERP as the company's single source of truth.

Retailer Requirements Management

• Build and maintain a centralized retailer requirements matrix documenting:

o Image specifications

o Product description requirements

o Required attributes

o Pricing fields

o Compliance requirements

• Keep documentation current as retailer standards evolve.

Product Launch Coordination

• Coordinate with Sales, Merchandising, Warehouse, and Photography teams to collect all required launch assets.

• Identify missing information and proactively follow up until every requirement is completed.

• Track all outstanding launch requests through completion.

Retailer Portal Management

• Upload products into retailer and marketplace portals.

• Verify listings after publication.

• Resolve listing errors within 48 hours of discovery.

Product Data Governance

• Manage updates to:

o Product costs

o Pricing

o Metal cost adjustments

o Product discontinuations

• Maintain proper change logs and ensure Business Central remains accurate.

Competitive & Retailer Research

• Perform scheduled retailer and competitor assortment scrapes using company templates.

• Deliver structured pricing and assortment reports to Sales and Merchandising teams.

Documentation & SOP Development

• Create and maintain SOPs for:

o Item creation

o Retailer upload processes

o Product data management

o Retailer scraping procedures

• Continuously improve documentation for scalability and operational consistency.

 

Escalation Process

Tier 1

• Resolve missing information and routine retailer portal issues independently.

Tier 2

• Escalate ERP or Business Central technical issues to ERP support.

Tier 3

• Escalate any issue impacting committed retailer launch dates directly to the President.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Less than 1% post-launch item setup error rate.

• 100% completion of Business Central item records before retailer uploads.

• Retailer requirements matrix reviewed and updated monthly.

• Product launches completed within retailer SLA once assets are received.

• 100% on-time delivery of scheduled retailer and competitor scrapes.

• Listing errors corrected within 48 hours.

 

Required Qualifications

• Minimum 2 years of experience in:

o Item setup

o Catalog management

o Product data operations

o Retail or e-commerce environments

• Experience onboarding products through retailer or marketplace portals such as:

o Walmart

o Sam's Club

o Amazon

o DSCO

o Similar enterprise retail platforms

• Experience working with ERP systems and item master data.

• Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience is highly preferred.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills with experience handling structured datasets.

• Excellent written English communication skills.

• Strong organizational and follow-up abilities.

• Available to work with meaningful overlap during US Pacific business hours.

 

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience within jewelry, precious metals, or luxury products.

• Knowledge of:

o Gold karats

o Metal fineness

o Stone specifications

• Experience creating SOPs and operational documentation.

• Understanding of retailer image specifications, including resolution, aspect ratio, and background standards.

 

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will:

• Be exceptionally detail-oriented and process-driven.

• Take full ownership of product data quality.

• Be proactive in coordinating multiple stakeholders.

• Thrive in a fast-paced operational environment.

• Have strong ERP and catalog management experience.

• Consistently ensure products are retailer-ready with minimal errors.

• Take initiative in preventing issues rather than reacting to them.



How to apply:

Respond to this job post with your current resume, a short introduction video, your expected hourly rate, and why you're the best fit for this role.



Application should send all the needed requirements to be considered for this role.

title: Virtual Home Health QA and Survey Readiness Specialist
description:
Philippines-Based Remote Position | Project-Based with Potential Long-Term Opportunity



A United States-based healthcare consulting agency is seeking an experienced Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance and Survey Readiness Specialist based in the Philippines.



Our consulting agency has been engaged to assist a California-based home health organization in preparing for an upcoming unannounced survey. We are seeking a knowledgeable, dependable, and detail-oriented professional who can support clinical record audits, documentation corrections, regulatory compliance, quality improvement, data preparation, and overall survey readiness.



The initial project is expected to begin in July 2026 and continue through October 2026. Based on performance, organizational needs, and mutual agreement, this opportunity may transition into a long-term position with our healthcare consulting agency.



As our company continues to grow, we plan to expand our services to include healthcare agency education, staff training, ongoing quality assurance, compliance monitoring, and follow-up support. The selected candidate may have the opportunity to assist with future client projects, educational programs, and training initiatives.



Position Overview

The selected specialist will work under the direction of the healthcare consulting team and collaborate with client leadership, clinical management, and administrative personnel.



The primary focus of the initial project will be to assist a Medicare-certified home health organization with Medicare and Joint Commission survey readiness.



The specialist will assist with documentation review and correction, clinical record audits, data collection and validation, graphing, dashboard development, trend analysis, and the preparation of reports, presentations, and educational materials.



Key Responsibilities

•	Conduct detailed quality assurance reviews of home health clinical records.

•	Review and correct clinical and administrative documentation for accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and regulatory compliance.

•	Audit OASIS assessments, plans of care, physician orders, face-to-face documentation, skilled nursing notes, therapy documentation, recertifications, transfers, and discharges.

•	Identify missing, incomplete, late, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation.

•	Clearly communicate audit findings and required corrections to the consulting team.

•	Track outstanding documentation and verify that corrections are completed.

•	Assist with data collection, organization, validation, and preparation.

•	Create and maintain graphs, charts, dashboards, audit summaries, correction logs, and trend reports.

•	Analyze audit findings and performance data to identify recurring deficiencies, compliance risks, and opportunities for improvement.

•	Assist with Medicare and Joint Commission survey-readiness activities.

•	Support mock audits, corrective action plans, QAPI activities, and compliance monitoring.

•	Assist with the preparation of professional reports, presentations, educational materials, training tools, audit forms, and agency resources.

•	Support ongoing follow-up and monitoring after the initial survey-readiness project.

•	Participate in scheduled virtual meetings with the consulting team and client representatives.

•	Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with HIPAA, privacy, and information-security requirements.



Required Qualifications

•	Previous quality assurance experience with a United States Medicare-certified home health agency.

•	Strong knowledge of Medicare home health documentation requirements.

•	Working knowledge of CMS Conditions of Participation.

•	Experience with Joint Commission standards and survey preparation.

•	Experience conducting home health clinical record audits and documentation corrections.

•	Knowledge of OASIS, plans of care, physician certification, face-to-face requirements, nursing documentation, and therapy documentation.

•	Experience using spreadsheets, audit tools, correction trackers, dashboards, graphs, and quality reports.

•	Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

•	Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow-through.

•	Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent communication with the consulting team.

•	Ability to manage deadlines and multiple quality-review priorities.

•	Reliable internet access and a private, secure workspace.



Preferred Qualifications

•	Experience using the Synergy EMR system.

•	Previous experience preparing a United States home health agency for a Joint Commission or Medicare survey.

•	Experience with QAPI, infection control, emergency preparedness, ADR reviews, corrective action plans, and compliance monitoring.

•	Experience creating graphs, dashboards, trend reports, and leadership 

•	Ability to support multiple healthcare clients as the consulting agency expands.

•	Availability to work hours that overlap with California Pacific Time when required.



Work Arrangement

•	Fully virtual and remote.

•	Applicants must be based in the Philippines.

•	Initial project period: July through October 2026.

•	Potential for long-term extension and expanded responsibilities.

•	Work will be completed under the direction of a United States-based healthcare consulting agency.

•	Scheduled meetings and project deadlines may follow California Pacific Time.

•	Secure system access will be provided based on assigned responsibilities.



Project Compensation

The compensation for the initial project-based engagement is $1,000 USD per month, paid semi-monthly in two installments of $500 USD.



Payment will be based on the timely completion of assigned duties, reports, audits, documentation reviews, and project deadlines.



If this project transitions into a long-term position, the compensation structure, salary, responsibilities, work schedule, and applicable benefits will be reviewed and adjusted based on performance, organizational needs, and the expanded scope of the position.



Potential Long-Term Responsibilities

The selected candidate may have the opportunity to continue supporting the consulting agency with:

•	Ongoing home health quality assurance reviews

•	Survey-readiness monitoring

•	Documentation correction and compliance follow-up

•	Quality improvement projects

•	Data analysis, dashboards, graphs, and quality reports

•	Staff education and training

•	Development of training materials and compliance tools

•	Virtual education programs for healthcare agencies

•	Support for additional healthcare consulting clients



How to Apply

Qualified applicants should submit:

•	A current résumé

•	A summary of United States home health QA experience

•	The number of years of experience reviewing Medicare home health records

•	Experience with Joint Commission survey preparation

•	A list of EMR systems used, including Synergy experience

•	Experience with documentation correction, data preparation, graphing, and dashboard development

•	Experience developing educational or training materials

•	Availability from July through October 2026

•	Preferred work schedule

•	Professional references, upon request



We are seeking a professional who is knowledgeable, dependable, collaborative, and committed to quality. The ideal candidate will understand that successful survey readiness is achieved through teamwork, education, accountability, accurate documentation, and consistent follow-up.



Applicants must have direct experience with United States home health quality assurance and Medicare documentation requirements.

A United States-based, nurse-led healthcare consulting and education company is seeking an experienced **Virtual Instructional Designer, E-Learning Course Builder, and Launch Support Specialist** based in the Philippines.

We are seeking the right technical and instructional-design professional to help transform that expertise into complete, professional, engaging, and marketable virtual training programs.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. The selected professional must have demonstrated experience developing curricula, building online courses, creating training materials, setting up learning platforms, and supporting course launches.



The engagement will begin as a project-based opportunity, with the potential to transition into a long-term position as the company expands its education and training division.



Position Overview

The selected professional will work directly with the CEO and subject-matter expert to develop and package her knowledge into structured training programs that can be:

* Taught live virtually

* Delivered through webinars and workshops

* Sold as self-paced online courses

* Purchased by organizations for their employees or leadership teams

* Offered as group coaching or cohort-based programs

* Licensed as train-the-trainer programs

* Packaged with workbooks, templates, tools, and other digital resources

Training Material Development

* Develop detailed facilitator guides and instructor notes.

* Prepare teaching scripts and video lesson outlines.

* Create participant workbooks, worksheets, templates, checklists, action plans, and downloadable resources.

* Develop realistic case studies, group activities, knowledge checks, quizzes, assessments, and evaluations.

* Create pre-training and post-training assessments.

* Develop certificates of completion.

* Ensure that all materials follow the company’s professional, warm, encouraging, and educational brand.



Online Platform Development

* Build the complete training program inside the selected platform.

* Set up course modules, lessons, videos, downloads, quizzes, assessments, and certificates.

* Configure participant registration and course-access processes.

* Integrate payment processing when applicable.

* Establish automated confirmation, welcome, reminder, completion, and follow-up
s.

* Create and organize the student or participant portal.

* Test the full participant experience from registration and payment through course completion.

Video and Virtual Training Support

title: YouTube Video Editor & Thumbnail Designer Needed (Part-Time / On-Call / Long-Term)
description:
I am currently looking for a reliable and talented YouTube video editor to help with my content on an on-call / as-needed basis.



This is a long-term position, but it is not full-time and hours are not guaranteed every week. Work will be assigned only when new videos are ready. This is a great fit for someone who already has ongoing clients and is looking to add another steady client with clear expectations and long-term potential.



I create educational and informational YouTube content, and I need an editor who understands how to make videos more engaging, more polished, and easier to watch without making them feel over-edited or distracting.



Type of Content

You will mainly be editing:



Talking-head YouTube videos

Educational, business, and informational content

Videos that need strong pacing, clarity, and professional presentation



The editing style should feel clean, modern, and engaging. I am not looking for excessive effects or overly flashy edits. The goal is to improve viewer experience and retention while keeping the content professional.



Your Responsibilities



Video Editing



Remove mistakes, pauses, filler words, and unnecessary sections

Tighten pacing to improve watch time and retention

Add clean cuts, zooms, light transitions, and simple motion effects

Add background music when appropriate

Add text, visual callouts, or simple graphics when needed

Follow editing instructions and keep a consistent style

Complete assigned projects on time



Thumbnail Design



Create professional and attention-grabbing YouTube thumbnails

Use strong contrast, bold layouts, and readable text

Make thumbnails optimized for both desktop and mobile

Keep designs clean and in line with the brand style



Ideal Applicant



Minimum 2 years of YouTube editing experience

Understands YouTube retention and pacing

Has edited talking-head or educational videos before

Can create strong thumbnails that improve click-through rate

Good English comprehension

Communicates well and responds in a timely manner

Detail-oriented and able to follow directions

Open to feedback and willing to make improvements

Can work independently and stay organized



Technical Requirements



Reliable internet connection

Quiet home-based workspace

Computer or laptop capable of handling video editing smoothly

Willing to use TimeProof for tracking time worked



Position Details



Pay: $3 USD per hour

Schedule: On-call / as needed

Hours: Vary depending on how many videos are being produced

Location: Remote

Payment: PayPal



How to Apply

Please send:



Links to videos you have personally edited

A short summary of your experience

The editing software you use

Thumbnail samples if available



To show that you read this job post carefully, begin your application with the word: RETENTION



This position is for someone who wants a long-term client relationship, communicates clearly, and takes pride in delivering quality work consistently.



I’m looking for someone dependable, easy to work with, and committed to doing great work over the long run.

title: Personal Assistant / Lead Response Specialist
description:
**Philippines · Remote · Long-term**



** Required - Send a 2 min Loom video why you would be a good fit for this position **

If you are serious, do NOT send generic intro videos. Send why you would be a great fit for THIS SPECIFIC opportunity.



---



About Us



GLOWE Clean is a fast-growing residential cleaning company serving busy families in California. We get a steady flow of inbound leads from online ads and need someone who can respond instantly, build rapport, and book appointments — so our founder can focus on growing the business.



This is a **long-term role** for someone who wants stability, responsibility, and the chance to grow with the company.



---



## The Role



You'll be the founder's **Personal Assistant + Lead Response Specialist**.



**Your #1 job:** Respond to new leads within 1 minute, warm them up via text (and occasional calls), and book them into our calendar.



You don't need to hard sell. You're the friendly first contact, not the closer.



We need someone who can cover a wide daily availability window (up to ~16 hours) using their phone and laptop. You won't be working nonstop — but you must stay alert to lead notifications and respond fast during your shift.



---



## Responsibilities



**Lead response & nurture**

- Monitor inbound leads (SMS / WhatsApp / CRM) during your shift

- Respond to **100% of new leads within 1 minute**

- Start friendly text conversations, ask simple qualifying questions (location, home size, timing, budget) using our scripts

- Make short warm-up calls when needed (no closing, no pricing negotiations)

- Book qualified leads into the founder's calendar

- Send reminders, confirmations, and follow-ups to reduce no-shows

- Run simple outbound follow-ups to older leads using our templates



**Personal assistant / admin**

- Manage the founder's calendar

- Keep our CRM (GoHighLevel) organized: tags, notes, pipeline stages

- Light inbox triage: flag important messages, archive the rest

- Simple admin tasks (spreadsheets, checklists, documenting processes)



---



## Schedule & Availability



- You won't be actively working every minute, but you must:

- Cover a long daily window (up to ~14 hours) aligned with US Pacific Time — for example, **5 AM – 8 PM PT** (which is **10 PM – 2 PM PHT the next day**)

- You won't be actively working every minute, but you must:

- Keep notifications on

- Respond to new leads within 1 minute

- Have daily focused blocks for follow-ups, admin, and calendar work

- Exact hours and breaks will be finalized together



?? **Important:** this is a graveyard shift role. Most of your work will fall during Philippine nighttime hours. Please only apply if you're comfortable working a night schedule long-term.



---



## Requirements



- Based in the **Philippines**

- Excellent written and spoken English — clear, friendly, professional

- Fast, reliable internet (fiber preferred) + smartphone for instant notifications

- Backup power and/or backup internet (brownout-ready)

- Comfortable texting and calling US homeowners

- Highly responsive, organized, detail-oriented

- **Plus:** BPO, real estate VA, or appointment-setting experience strongly preferred (OnlineJobs.ph, Upwork, or agency background all welcome)



---



## What Success Looks Like (after 30-day ramp-up)



- Responding to 100% of new leads within 1 minute during your shift

- Running daily follow-ups on all open leads

- Consistently booking qualified appointments for the founder

- Calendar and CRM stay clean, accurate, and up to date

- Proactively reminding the founder of key tasks and appointments



Strong performance = pay raises and bonuses tied to booked jobs and retention.



---



## Compensation



- **USD $800/month**

- Full-time, long-term

- Paid monthly via Wise, PayPal, or similar (mutually agreed)

- 13th month consideration after 1 year of strong performance



---



## How to Apply



Please send the following:



**1. Short intro (1–2 paragraphs)**

- Your city/province in the Philippines

- Your experience with customer communication, appointment setting, or executive assistance

- Confirmation that you can work US Pacific Time hours (graveyard shift) long-term



**2. A 2 minute Loom video** (required) where you:

- Introduce yourself and your background

- Explain why you're a good fit for a fast-response, long-availability role on a night shift

- Read this sample message out loud as if texting a new lead:



> *"Hey Sarah, this is [Your Name] from GLOWE Clean. Thanks for reaching out! I'd love to help you get a quote. First, can you tell me your city, how many bedrooms and bathrooms you have, and how soon you'd like your home cleaned?"*



**3. Include the word "LIME"** somewhere in your message so we know you read the full post.

title: Homecare Services Coordinator
description:
Comfort Keepers is a well-established, mission-driven home care agency serving seniors and older adults in the greater Virginia area.. We believe that every person has an inner spark — something age and illness cannot take away — and our job is to help keep it burning.

We are looking for a full-time remote Homecare Services Coordinator (HSC) based in the Philippines to join our team long-term. This is a high-responsibility, people-facing role. You will be on the phone every day with clients, families, and caregivers — and your work directly affects the quality of care our clients receive.



Compensation & Benefits

• $5–$7/hour depending on experience

• 45 hours per week

• Paid twice monthly — 1st and 15th of each month

• 13th Month Pay provided in accordance with Philippine law

• Retention bonus starting at $200 at every 6-month anniversary, with performance-based increases

• Room for advancement — as our team grows, we promote from within. High performers will have the opportunity to take on leadership roles managing our Philippines-based team

• Long-term position — we value loyalty and invest in people who invest in us





What You’ll Do

• Manage caregiver schedules in WellSky and ensure all client shifts are covered (training on WellSky provided)

• Handle call-offs, no-shows, and last-minute schedule changes quickly and calmly

• Answer inbound calls via RingCentral from caregivers, clients, and families

• Conduct intake calls with prospective clients — guide them with warmth, professionalism, and accurate information about our services

• Communicate shift assignments and schedule changes to caregivers and clients

• Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts using independent judgment

• Document all interactions and schedule notes accurately and completely

• Support general administrative tasks using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Assist with caregiver onboarding and follow-up as needed



What We’re Looking For

Required:

• Excellent spoken and written English — you will be speaking with seniors and their families daily; this is a firm requirement, not a preference

• Minimum 2 years of experience in scheduling, healthcare administration, customer service, or a US-facing call center role

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Experience with RingCentral or similar VOIP systems

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to stay calm under pressure

• Highly organized with outstanding attention to detail

• Reliable primary internet connection with a backup

• Quiet, professional home workspace

• Available to work overnight and shifting schedules including weekends and US holidays — see schedule details below

A Strong Plus:

• Experience with WellSky, ClearCare, or similar home care scheduling software

• Prior experience supporting a US-based home care, home health, or hospice agency

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant
description:
QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant



We are a growing exterior cleaning and handyman company based in British Columbia, Canada. We are looking for a detail-oriented QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant to become a long-term member of our team.



This is not just a bookkeeping position. We are looking for someone who takes pride in keeping financial records accurate, organized, and audit-ready while also helping with administrative tasks as our business grows.



We use QuickBooks Online and follow the Profit First cash management system. Accuracy, integrity, and attention to detail are far more important than speed.



Our company follows the Profit First cash management system. Experience with Profit First is an asset but not required. During onboarding, the successful candidate will be expected to become familiar with the principles of Profit First by Mike Michalowicz. We encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate learning and deepen understanding of the concepts. The successful candidate will also be trained on and expected to follow our documented accounting policies, procedures, and workflows, which are based on the Profit First methodology.

• Organize files in Google Drive

Preferred Qualifications



• QuickBooks Online Certification

• Familiarity with the Profit First methodology



What We're Looking For

• Are honest and dependable

HoneyBook — Create and send client invoices, track payment status, follow up on unpaid/overdue invoices, manage recurring retainer invoices, keep client billing records organized

Wise — Process contractor payments on schedule (we pay our team on the 28th of each month), manage international transfers, track fees and exchange rates, keep payment records clean

QuickBooks — Categorize transactions, reconcile bank/card accounts weekly, record all income and expenses, keep the chart of accounts tidy, prepare simple monthly reports (revenue, expenses, profit by client)

Creator payments 

Overcommunicate — If a client hasn't paid, if a payment fails, if anything looks off — we hear about it the same day, not after it becomes a problem

Must-Haves

2+ years of hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (not just "familiar with" — you've actually run reconciliations and monthly closes)

Real experience with Wise for international/contractor payments

Experience with HoneyBook or a similar invoicing CRM (Dubsado, FreshBooks, Bonsai — and able to learn HoneyBook fast)

Excellent written English — you'll follow up with US clients on invoices

Detail-obsessed. A $50 discrepancy bothers you until you find it

Nice-to-Haves

Experience working with US agencies or e-commerce brands

QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification

Experience building simple finance SOPs or trackers in Notion/Google Sheets

Pay & Growth

Start at $6–8/hour based on experience, ~2–4 hours/day

Paid monthly on a fixed date via Wise — we never pay our own team late

90-day raise path: crush your number consistently for 90 days and your rate goes up. We reward results, and there's room to grow into a full-time finance/ops role as we scale
