title: Bookkeeper
description:
Job Title: Bookkeeper

Location: Cincinnati, OH

Position: Full-Time, Remote

Pay Structure: Base

Pay: $8-$10 USD per hour

Benefits: NA



About the Company

Rowling Homes is a fast-growing, Cincinnati-based real estate investment company on a mission to become the most trusted home buyer in the country. In just 3 years, we have built a results-driven, high-energy culture where every tea
mber is empowered to make an impact. Between Rowling Homes and our sister company, Sharper Capital Partners, we added five in-person tea
mbers in 2025 alone — and we're not slowing down.

We are a team that works hard, wins together, and holds ourselves to a high standard. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and want your work to directly move the needle, you'll feel right at home here.



Our Core Values

• Drive — We bring energy and intensity to everything we do. Half-measures aren't in our vocabulary.

• Integrity — We do what we say. Honest, transparent, and accountable to each other and our clients.

• Accountability — We own our results — the wins and the lessons. No excuses, only solutions.

• Continuous Improvement — We are never satisfied with the status quo. We learn, adapt, and level up every day.

• Teamwork — We win as one. Egos stay at the door; collaboration and mutual support drive our success.



Role Overview

We are hiring an experienced Bookkeeper to own the day-to-day financial recordkeeping that keeps our operations running smoothly. In a typical day, you will be recording the prior day's transactions in QuickBooks, entering and verifying invoices, tracking down receipts and supporting documentation, and coordinating with teammates and vendors to keep our books accurate, complete, and audit-ready.



This is a role for a self-starter. You are expected to take initiative to complete your work — proactively chasing down missing documentation, following up with vendors, flagging discrepancies, and keeping the books current without being asked. You own your workload from start to finish.



Responsibilities

• Record all transactions in QuickBooks on a daily basis, ensuring the prior day's activity is fully and accurately processed.

• Track down, collect, and maintain invoices, receipts, and supporting documentation so that every transaction is paired with its backup.

• Handle accounts payable through the full cycle up until payment approval — entering invoices, verifying accuracy, and confirming invoices are good for payment.

• Perform monthly bank reconciliations across multiple entities and accounts.

• Handle vendor onboarding, including collecting W-9s and required documentation and entering vendors into QuickBooks.

• Perform regular vendor management, including collecting invoices, maintaining vendor records, and ensuring ongoing vendor compliance.

• Document processes and procedures to build and maintain a reliable, repeatable bookkeeping system.

• Prepare monthly financial statements and update KPIs.

• Assist with process development and improvement, and support special projects such as tax preparation and month-end reconciliations.



How Performance Is Measured

Success in this role is clearly defined. You will be measured on:

• Processing the prior day's transactions in QuickBooks accurately and on time, every day.

• Entering all invoices and confirming invoices are good for payment within 24 hours

• Maintaining vendor compliance, including complete vendor records and documentation every month

• Assisting with process development, process improvement, and special projects such as tax prep and month-end reconciliations and property/loan servicing



Vision for the role:

The bookkeeper position is a dynamic role that requires both written and verbal communication. This means you will have to make calls from to collect the information you need. This is the expectation. As our company grows, the workload will likely exceed the responsibility for one bookkeeper. We will make available the staff accountant position when we need to seperate the different accounting functionalities like bookkeeping, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.



Required Qualifications

• 3+ years of significant bookkeeping experience.

• Strong working knowledge of accounting fundamentals and QuickBooks.

• Proven ability to take initiative and own your work — you complete tasks without waiting to be told.

• Experience with bank reconciliations, accounts payable, and vendor management.

• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

• High integrity and ethical standards.

• Team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues.

• Excellent time management skills with the ability to work with strict deadlines.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment.

• Experience with Google Suite or similar software (i.e., Microsoft Office Suite).

• Degree or certification in a related field (e.g., Accounting, Finance, etc.).



Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience documenting processes and building standard operating procedures.

title: Technical Operations & Automation Specialist (Zapier / ManyChat / CRM's SOP Documentation)
description:
?? STOP — READ THIS BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE ??



YOUR APPLICATION WILL NOT BE OPENED WITHOUT A LOOM VIDEO.



To apply, you MUST include a link to a 2–3 minute screen-recorded Loom video (
 — free account) in which you:



Open any CRM, spreadsheet, or automation tool you have personally used (HubSpot, Zapier, ManyChat, GoHighLevel, Google Sheets — your choice) and walk us through, on screen, how you would document ONE workflow inside it.



We are evaluating three things: your spoken English, your ability to navigate software on camera, and how you organize information. No video = automatic rejection. No exceptions.



WHO WE ARE



R3volution AD Services, Inc. is a Houston-based digital marketing, AI platform development, and government contracting firm, operating since 2017. We build custom AI-powered systems — including our own proprietary CRM and AI voice-calling platform — for clients in healthcare, legal, manufacturing, and the public sector. We are lean, fast, and building aggressively. You will report directly to the Founder & CEO.



This is NOT a task-rabbit VA role. This is an operations seat at a growing agency. You will touch marketing, publishing, automation, project management, and sales operations. If you want a job where someone hands you a checklist every morning, do not apply. If you want to run the engine room of an American agency and grow with it, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



1. Systems & Automation Integration





Connect our social networks, marketing platforms, and tools into our central operations dashboard (Zapier, native integrations, webhooks)

Build, test, and maintain automations: lead capture ? CRM ? notification ? follow-up sequences

Learn and operate our proprietary custom CRM (full training and documentation provided — your job is to master it, run it, and document it; development changes are approved by the CEO only)





2. SOP Documentation & Quality Assurance





Write clear, step-by-step SOPs in Google Docs for every recurring workflow in the company

Run QA test passes on our systems (booking flows, follow-up sequences, reminder automations) and deliver written bug reports with screenshots

Maintain the company SOP library so any future hire can be trained from documentation alone





3. Content & Social Growth Operations





Manage the video content pipeline: the CEO records the videos — you coordinate editing, captioning, scheduling, and posting across platforms 
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok)

Track engagement, capture inbound leads from social into the CRM, and report weekly on what content is producing conversations

Manage ManyChat (or equivalent) flows for social lead capture and qualification





4. Publishing Operations (2 Books Per Quarter)





Run the book production pipeline: manuscript milestones, formatting, cover coordination, Amazon KDP upload, and launch promotion checklist

Keep the publishing calendar on schedule — two titles per quarter, every quarter





5. Project & Sales Operations Oversight





Track all active projects in our project management tool: owners, deadlines, blockers — and flag risks to the CEO before they become fires

Support sales operations alongside the CEO: CRM pipeline hygiene, appointment tracking, follow-up task management, weekly pipeline reports

Assist in developing and scoping new projects and offers as the company grows





REQUIRED SKILLS & TOOLS

We have our own Custom CRM, so it helps if you have exp. in these.



Zapier (must be able to build multi-step Zaps with filters/paths)

ManyChat or equivalent chat automation platform

At least one major CRM (HubSpot, GoHigh-Level, Zoho, Salesforce, or similar) — AND the ability to learn our custom-built CRM quickly

LinkedIn, Meta Business Suite, and multi-platform social scheduling

Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive) at an advanced level

Canva (basic graphics/formatting)

Excellent written and spoken English — you will communicate with the CEO daily by voice and in writing

Self-starter discipline: you Google it, you test it, you document it — THEN you ask a smart question if still stuck





Bonus (not required): Amazon KDP experience, Miro/flowcharting, Notion or ClickUp, basic understanding of webhooks/JSON, video editing coordination experience.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



OnlineJobs.ph ID Proof score of 70 or higher. Applications below 70 will not be reviewed.

Time-zone overlap: minimum 3–4 hours of your working day must overlap with Houston, Texas business hours (US Central Time). State your committed overlap hours in your application. During government proposal season, responsiveness during those hours is mandatory.

Daily end-of-day written report (what was done, what's blocked, what's next). Going silent for 24 hours during probation is automatic termination.

Full-time, dedicated — no double-dipping with other full-time clients.



COMPENSATION & TERMS





Starting at: $600–$800 USD per month, full-time, depending on demonstrated skill level — paid reliably via Deel

Pre testing task for shortlisted candidates BEFORE any hiring decision — Your time

7-day probation with clear daily deliverables, then confirmation to permanent full-time

Performance reviews with a real growth path — this seat grows into an Operations Manager role as the agency scales

Long-term stability: we have operated since 2017 and we are building for the next decade



HOW TO APPLY





Your Loom video link (see the top of this post — mandatory)

Your OnlineJobs.ph profile with ID Proof score visible

A short written answer (5–8 sentences, in your own words — we can tell when AI writes it): "Describe one automation or system you personally built or ran, what problem it solved, and one thing that broke that you fixed yourself."

Your committed Houston-overlap hours

Your expected monthly salary within the posted range





One more thing. To prove you read this entire post, the subject line of your application must be exactly:



Blue Pineapple – [Your Full Name] – Technical Ops



Applications without this exact subject line are deleted unread, even with a perfect Loom video.



THE ROLE — WHAT YOU ARE WALKING INTO

Read this part twice, because we're not going to dress it up.

R3volution AD Services is not one website. It's a portfolio: a commercial digital marketing division, a manufacturing/B2B marketing division, proprietary AI platforms we've built and are bringing to market, a custom CRM with an AI voice-calling system, an active government contracting pipeline, and a Founder/CEO who publishes and launches constantly. You will not manage those other properties — but you will be the operator who makes sure that when something ships from anywhere in this house, the machine around it fires perfectly. The CEO writes a book — you're rolling out the campaign: socials, blogs,
, launch calendar, all scheduled before launch day, not after. A platform hits a milestone — same. You need to know the whole board even when you're only moving your pieces.

You report directly to the Head CEO / Founder. You lead the tea
etings — editors, contributors, project contributors answer into you, and you answer to him. You will sit in meetings with potential clients. And yes: you are expected to help bring accounts into this company that carry real value. Your day-to-day is built to produce that. If you're looking for a seat where you quietly manage tasks in the background, this is the wrong posting. If you are beyond hungry to build your name in the digital media marketing space on a stage that's already moving — this is the one.

MANDATE ONE — FUNNEL INTEGRITY (your first standing priority, day one)

Before anything else, you own the pipeline end to end: every landing page loads and converts, every form fires, every workflow routes, every automation completes — lead in, appointment booked, confirmation out, follow-up scheduled. You audit it, you fix routing gaps, you document it, and then you keep it at 100%. Nothing in this company gets marketed into a broken funnel. This is not a one-time project — it's the floor you defend every week while you build everything else on top of it.

DAILY OPERATING RHYTHM

Revenue Block — every day:



Work the inbox like it's money, because it is: every inquiry, referral, and warm reply triaged and answered same day — nothing ages 24 hours

Sit in and support meetings with potential clients; own the follow-up — recap sent, next step booked, CRM updated before end of day

Build and work the target account list in our niches (healthcare, legal, manufacturing): research, outreach support, opportunities flagged to the CEO with context — your pipeline contribution is tracked weekly, and it's expected to grow



Command Block — every day:



Run the team: assignments clear, editors and contributors unblocked, deadlines enforced — problems come to you first and reach the CEO only with a proposed solution attached

Move every active project one step forward daily — book pipeline, content pipeline, launch prep, client deliverables. Idle projects are your failure, not the team's



Production Block — every day:



Content live across all platforms on schedule; yesterday's numbers scored — what earned reach, what earned leads, what gets cut

Every new lead captured, tagged, routed, follow-up set — zero leads untouched past 4 business hours

One improvement shipped daily: an SOP written or updated, an automation extended, a funnel asset tightened. The backlog is public and never empty — if you're waiting for work, you've failed the role



LAUNCH READINESS — ALWAYS ON

You maintain a launch playbook for every property in the portfolio, so when the CEO says "it ships," you're executing a campaign that already exists — social calendar, blog schedule,
 sequence, landing page verified — not starting a document. A launch you learned about the day it happened is a launch you were supposed to already be ready for.

WEEKLY — YOU RUN THE MEETINGS



Monday — YOU book and run the Weekly Ops Briefing with the CEO (15 minutes, agenda sent the night before): funnel status, pipeline and account numbers, launch readiness, team output, and the decisions you need. You bring answers. The CEO's calendar is for new business and new direction — every other meeting in this company is yours to run

Midweek — you run the tea
eting: deliverables reviewed, next week loaded, underperformance addressed by you

Friday — Ship Report: everything shipped, scored against target; next week's content and milestones pre-loaded; one growth proposal — an offer, automation, or account play you recommend, with the why. Every Friday. The #1 agency doesn't wait for the CEO to invent the next move



MONTHLY — WHAT YOUR NAME GETS BUILT ON



Month-end Growth Report: funnel conversion, accounts advanced, revenue contribution, content trend, launch pipeline status

One client-facing asset shipped monthly (case study, lead magnet, campaign template) the sales side can deploy

Team performance review delivered to the CEO — who's producing, who's not, and your recommendation



The honest close: this seat is demanding, measured weekly, and reports to a Founder who moves fast and expects you to move faster. In exchange, you're running operations for a multi-brand agency and AI platform portfolio, leading a team, sitting in real deals, and building a track record you can put your name on. Bring hunger. We'll match it with a stage.



WHY THIS SEAT — WHAT YOU GET

We'll be straight with you here the same way we were about the workload. This is a remote contractor role 

100% remote, permanently. No commute, no office, no relocation — ever. Work from home, work from anywhere. Your environment is yours.

Freedom with accountability. We measure output, not hours in a chair. Hit your deliverables and run your blocks — nobody is watching your mouse move. You're treated like the professional you are, from day one.

Direct line to the Founder & Head CEO. No layers, no middle managers, no waiting three weeks for a decision. You brief him weekly, you get answers same day, and you learn how an agency owner actually thinks and moves — daily.

Mentorship you cannot buy. You'll work directly under a founder who built this company from zero without outside capital — across digital marketing, AI platforms, publishing, and government contracting. This is a working education in the business of the business, not just the tasks.

No glass ceiling. This company is built in Houston, Texas — but this seat has no ceiling on it. You start as our Operations Manager; where you go from there is d
 by your output, not your passport, not your location, not your title history. The right person grows as fast as the company does — and the company is moving.

Quarterly and annual bonuses. Hit your KPIs — funnel performance, launch execution, account contribution — and you're paid above your salary, every quarter, with an annual bonus on top. Your wins are your money, not just the company's.

A master portfolio with your name on it. Multi-platform campaigns, product and book launches, AI platform rollouts, a custom CRM ecosystem, real client accounts in healthcare, legal, and manufacturing. Two years in this seat is a body of work most digital marketers never touch in ten. If you're building a name in this space, this is where names get built.

Stability with velocity. We've operated since 2017. This isn't a startup that vanishes in eight months — it's an established firm in growth mode. You get the security of a company with history and the adrenaline of one that's climbing.

Paid, reliable, on time — every time. Contracted and paid through Deel. No chasing invoices, no "next week." Professional structure, professional treatment.



We're not hiring someone to survive here. We're hiring someone to rise here.

title: Back-Office Admin Assistant for U.S. Residential Construction Company
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a residential exterior contracting company based in Massachusetts, USA (roofing, siding, windows, decks). We are hiring our first dedicated virtual assistant to own the back-office and administrative side of the business. This is a long-term, part-time role to start, with a path to more hours and responsibility. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with a company over years, learn our systems deeply, and eventually take on more, not someone looking for a short-term gig.

Most tasks do not need to be done at a specific time of day, so your hours are largely flexible, with the exception of occasional phone calls to U.S. offices during U.S. business hours (see below).



WHAT YOU WILL DO

-Data entry and upkeep inside our project management software (JobTread): entering job costs, keeping job statuses current, and keeping records clean and trustworthy.

-Tracking and organizing invoices, bills, and receipts, coding each expense to the correct job and category.

-Auditing supplier invoices against agreed pricing and flagging discrepancies or overcharges.

-Reconciling purchase orders against supplier invoices.

-Preparing building permit applications: filling out online town portal forms from information we provide, uploading documents, and tracking status. This may occasionally require phone calls to U.S. town building departments during U.S. business hours to follow up. You will not make decisions on scope. We handle all judgment calls and approvals.

-Scheduling and organizing social media posts from content and images we provide.

-General data entry and administrative tasks as the business grows.



WHO YOU ARE

-Extremely detail-oriented. You catch small errors others miss, and a wrong number bothers you.

-Disciplined and consistent. You do routine work accurately every time without reminders.

-A clear communicator in English, written and spoken. Most work is async and written, but you will occasionally make clear, professional phone calls to U.S. building departments, so comfortable spoken English is required.

-Someone who asks a clarifying question when unsure instead of guessing. This is the single most important trait to us.

-Comfortable learning new software. You do not need to know JobTread already, but you need to be able to learn it and own it.

-Reliable and honest. We are trusting you with financial records and job data.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

-Experience with bookkeeping, accounting support, or expense management.

-Experience supporting a construction, trades, or home services business.

-Experience with any project management or CRM software (extra bonus if you have experience with JobTread).

-Fluency with AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT for drafting, summarizing, and speeding up routine work.



DETAILS

-Part-time to start, with a path to more hours and expanded responsibility for the right person.

-Flexible hours, aside from occasional U.S.-business-hours calls.

-Long-term position. We are building a relationship, not filling a slot.

-Paid trial task before any offer, so both sides know it is a fit.



HOW TO APPLY

To apply, start your message with the word ROOFING so we know you actually read this post. Applications that do not begin with that word will not be read.



In your message, please tell us:



-Your experience with data entry, bookkeeping, or expense tracking.

-Any project management or CRM software you have used.

-How long you stayed in your two most recent roles, and why you left.

-Your availability and expected rate.



We read every application that follows the instructions above and reply to the strongest fits.

title: Assistant Production Accountant (Contract)
description:
Who We Are



At TRADEMARK, we transform bold ideas into jaw-dropping experiences. As a global corporate event production agency, we collaborate with leading brands across technology, entertainment, healthcare, education, philanthropy, and financial services to design events that captivate and inspire.



From large-scale conferences and sales kickoffs to intimate brand activations and executive experiences, we deliver the extraordinary through thoughtful planning, strong systems, and exceptional execution.



The Role



TRADEMARK is seeking a contract Assistant Production Accountant to support invoice data entry and accounting-related paperwork for our production teams. This role sits within the Accounting department and focuses on administrative support for Sage Intacct, vendor documentation, and production accounting workflows.



The Assistant Production Accountant supports the Accounting team by ensuring check requests, purchase orders, and related vendor information are entered accurately and consistently into Sage Intacct. This role also helps collect, organize, and track accounting documentation, including W-9s and other vendor paperwork required to support accounting tasks related to production.



Designed specifically to support production-facing accounting operations, this position serves as a key partner to Production Managers and Lead Producers by maintaining accurate records, streamlining administrative processes, and supporting the day-to-day accounting needs of live projects and events.



What You’ll Do



Invoice Data Entry



 • Enter check requests and purchase orders for vendor invoices and related details into Sage Intacct accurately and consistently

 • Review invoices for basic completeness before entry of CRs and POs, including vendor name, invoice number, project information, amount, and supporting documentation and details

 • Ensure information is entered according to Accounting department standards and project coding guidelines

 • Flag missing information, unclear details, or discrepancies to the appropriate Accounting team and/or Production tea
mber

 • Maintain accurate records of check request and purchase order entry status, and follow up on incomplete items as directed

 • Support timely and organized invoice processing by keeping Sage Intacct data current



Accounting Paperwork Support

 • Assist with collecting, organizing, and filing invoices in designated show folders

 • Assist with collecting, organizing, and filing vendor W-9 forms

 • Help track missing or incomplete vendor paperwork needed for invoice processing or project records

 • Maintain organized digital records of accounting-related vendor documentation

 • Support the Accounting team with other clerical paperwork needs related to production projects

 • Ensure sensitive vendor, financial, and project information is handled with discretion



Production Team Support

 • Provide clerk-level accounting support to Project Managers, Lead Producers, and Accounting as it relates to Sage and invoice paperwork

 • Help PMs and LPs understand what information is missing when invoices or vendor documents cannot be processed

 • Communicate clearly and professionally when following up on missing invoice details, W-9s, or other required documentation

 • Keep Accounting informed of recurring issues, incomplete submissions, or process gaps

 • Support a smoother handoff between Production and Accounting by helping keep invoice and vendor documentation organized



Administrative Accuracy & Process

 • Follow established Accounting department processes for data entry, filing, and documentation

 • Maintain a high level of accuracy across repetitive, detail-oriented work

 • Keep shared trackers, folders, or records updated as needed

 • Ask questions when information is unclear rather than making assumptions

 • Help create consistency in how production-related invoice information is captured and entered into Sage



What You’ll Bring

 • 2+ years of experience in data entry, accounting administration, accounts payable support, bookkeeping support, office administration, or a related clerical role

 • Experience entering invoices or financial information into an accounting system is a plus

 • Familiarity with Sage Intacct or a similar accounting platform is a plus

 • Comfort working with invoices, vendor records, W-9s, Certificates of Insurance, and other administrative paperwork

 • Strong attention to detail and accuracy

 • Basic spreadsheet skills and comfort working with organized data

 • Strong written and verbal communication skills

 • Ability to follow processes, manage repetitive tasks, and keep information organized

 • Experience supporting production, events, creative agencies, hospitality, or project-based work is a plus, but not required



What Success Looks Like 

Success in this role means that invoice information is entered accurately into Sage Intacct, vendor paperwork is organized, and the Accounting team has cleaner, more consistent support for production-related invoice processing.



You will: 

 • Enter invoice information into Sage accurately and consistently

 • Help reduce missing or incomplete invoice details before they slow down processing

 • Keep W-9s and related vendor paperwork organized and easy to find

 • Provide reliable clerk-level support to Accounting, Project Managers, and Lead Producers

 • Follow established Accounting processes without overstepping into production coordination responsibilities

 • Communicate clearly when information is missing, unclear, or needs review

 • Bring steady, organized follow-through to detail-heavy administrative work

Because we run a dynamic operation, we are looking for a sharp, self-motivated, and highly organized professional to handle our back-office backbone: Human Resources, compliance, and financial administration.  



Job Overview

We are seeking a full-time HR, Payroll, and Operations Coordinator to manage our team’s hours, compliance certifications, camp permits, insurance, and bill payments.



This position deals heavily with California employment and labor laws. While you don't need to be an expert on day one, you must have the drive to study and learn these complex regulations. To support your growth, we will fully pay for your time spent training and studying these laws.



Key Responsibilities

-HR & Payroll Administration: Gather and verify weekly hours from individual staff members and department heads; process payroll accurately and on time.



-Labor Law Compliance & Policy Enforcement: Learn and master specific rules regarding meal/rest breaks, overtime regulations, and other standard workplace laws. Monitor time tracking and proactively help enforce these company policies across all departments.



-Compliance & Certifications: Track and monitor staff training progress and mandatory certifications to ensure 100% compliance.



-Permit & Insurance Management: Track, manage, and renew all necessary camp operational permits; oversee insurance requirements and ensure we meet all policy guidelines.



-Financial Accounts Payable: Manage and execute timely bill payments for camp operations.



-Sales support type tasks, as time allows.



Schedule & Shift Details

-Working Hours: approx. 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM PST (Pacific Standard Time) / Note: This is approximately 1:00 AM – 10:00 AM PHT.

-Work Days: 5 days a week Monday - Friday.

-Break: Proposed 1 hour total break time per shift.



Quality Remote Work Setup -- Because you will be communicating with leadership and handling sensitive data, you will need a reliable remote working environment:

-Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace where you can focus and take meetings without major distractions.

Communication: A clear webcam and a reliable headset with noise-canceling features for tea
etings via Zoom and phone calls.

-Internet & Power: High-speed internet connection. A backup power solution (like a UPS) and a secondary internet option (like mobile data or a pocket Wi-Fi) are strongly preferred to handle occasional outages.

title: Amazon Product Sourcing VA / Online Arbitrage Product Researcher
description:
I am looking for a detail-oriented Amazon Product Sourcing VA to help find profitable products for an Amazon resale business.



Your main responsibility will be finding profitable product leads using storefront sourcing / storefront stalking.



The process is simple but requires attention to detail:



You will start with an Amazon seller storefront, go through the products they are selling, use SellerAmp to check if the products meet our criteria, and then search online to find where those products can be purchased profitably.



When you find a winning product, you will then look at other sellers on that same Amazon listing, open their storefronts, and repeat the process.



The goal is to continuously find profitable products that meet our buying criteria and submit them clearly in a Google Sheet for review.



?



Main Responsibilities



* Review Amazon seller storefronts to find potential products

* Use SellerAmp to analyze products

* Check sales rank, monthly sales, offer count, warnings, Amazon competition, and price history

* Avoid products with IP complaint warnings, private label warnings, weak demand, or unstable pricing

* Search Google Shopping and Google Search to find profitable buying sources

* Check retail websites, promo codes, coupon codes, and simple discounts

* Calculate profitability using SellerAmp

* Add qualified product leads to a Google Sheet

* Include the Amazon link, ASIN, source link, buy cost, selling price, estimated profit, ROI, and notes

* Follow a repeatable process every day



?



Product Criteria



You will be looking for products that meet these criteria:



* Amazon sales rank under 200,000

* At least 100 estimated sales per month

* No IP complaint warning

* No private label warning

* Amazon is not selling the product, or Amazon is not price competitive

* Stable selling price

* Competition is not increasing rapidly while price is falling

* Monthly sales should ideally be at least 3x the number of competing offers

* Product can be purchased from a legitimate retail website

* Product has at least 30% ROI after estimated shipping cost



For calculations, we will use a fixed estimated shipping cost of $1.50.



?



What You Will Submit



For every qualified lead, you will submit:



* Amazon product title

* ASIN

* Amazon listing link

* Source website link

* Buy cost

* Estimated shipping cost

* Amazon selling price used

* Estimated profit

* ROI percentage

* Monthly sales

* Sales rank

* Number of sellers/offers

* Whether Amazon is on the listing

* Promo code used, if any

* Notes or concerns



The source link is very important. Do not submit a product unless you found where it can be purchased profitably.



?



Required Skills



* Experience with Amazon product research

* Experience with SellerAmp preferred

* Experience with Keepa preferred

* Experience with online arbitrage preferred

* Strong Google research skills

* Comfortable using Google Sheets

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to follow clear criteria

* Ability to work independently

* Good written English

* Reliable internet connection

* Own laptop or desktop computer



?



Nice to Have



* Experience sourcing for Amazon FBA or FBM

* Experience with storefront stalking / storefront sourcing

* Experience using coupon tools or promo code research

* Experience calculating ROI and profit margins

* Understanding of sales rank, Buy Box, Keepa charts, and Amazon competition



?



Who This Is For



This role is for someone who is patient, detail-oriented, and good at repetitive research.



I do not need someone who guesses. I need someone who can follow criteria, check the numbers carefully, and submit clean product leads that are easy to review.



Quality matters more than volume.



A few strong leads are better than many bad leads.

Who we are:



The Land Pioneer (
) is a vacant land acquisitions and dispositions business. We buy raw land at a discount, then sell it. Cold calling is the engine of our pipeline — without great callers, nothing else moves.



Who we're looking for:



We're hiring 6–10 cold callers who already know how to sell. We are NOT going to train you on:



How to handle objections:



How to build rapport in the first 15 seconds

What a motivated seller actually sounds like

Why "just thinking about it" isn't a real objection



If you're early in your sales career and looking for someone to teach you scripts and tonality, this isn't the role. We need experienced callers — people who can pick up a phone, navigate a conversation, keep a stranger on the line, and know within two minutes whether the person on the other end is a real lead, a maybe, or a tire-kicker. You should be able to filter hot from cold without us looking over your shoulder.



Must-haves:



Real estate cold calling experience in the US market. Vacant land experience is a major plus and will likely earn you a higher starting rate.



Neutral or American accent with strong English fluency. You should sound like someone a US homeowner would comfortably talk to for ten minutes without feeling like they're on a "sales call."



A proven track record. We will ask for references and metrics — dials per day, contact rates, qualified leads passed, deals sourced.



Recorded calls we can listen to. Non-negotiable. If you don't have them, don't apply. Redact PII where needed, but we want to hear you in action — wins and tough calls both.



Reliable internet, a quality headset, a quiet workspace, and the ability to overlap with US time zones.



Adaptability. Our process evolves. We test scripts, swap list sources, refine criteria. You should welcome that, not resist it.



What you'll be doing:



Calling property owners from lists we provide

Use our software to look at the property features

Provide range offers to the sellers (After training)

Building rapport quickly, finding motivation, qualifying or disqualifying fast

Passing warm, vetted leads to our acquisitions team

Logging clean notes in our CRM

Hitting daily and weekly KPIs on dials, contacts, and qualified leads



Compensation:



Hourly base



Junior callers (less experience but strong fundamentals): $4/hr

Seasoned callers (verifiable track record, especially in land): higher base — we'll discuss based on what you bring



Acquisition bonus:



For Junior Cold Callers: $75 paid as soon as a deal closes on the acquisitions side from a lead you sourced. This applies during probation and continues after.



For Experienced Cold Callers: $150 paid as soon as a deal closes on the acquisitions side from a lead you sourced. This applies during probation and continues after.



After 90 days (post-probation)



You graduate onto our tier-based back-end comp plan. When a deal you sourced closes full cycle — meaning we've bought it AND sold it on the dispositions side — you get paid out of the sales funds when they hit our account. This is where the real money is for our long-term callers. We're not playing games with comp; when we win, you win.

title: Cold-Caller for Startup Company
description:
We help small, local businesses — dealerships, contractors, salons, and other service businesses — save time by automating the repetitive parts of running their business: appointment reminders, invoicing, lead follow-up, and review requests. We're a young, growing company based in Texas, and this role is a chance to be part of that growth from an early stage.

What You'll Actually Be Doing



Making outbound calls to a pre-researched list of local businesses (we typically provide the full list, phone numbers, and specific talking points for each one)

Following a simple, natural script introducing Clear Fork Automations and identifying whether the business owner is interested in a short follow-up conversation

Logging every call outcome in a shared tracker (connected, voi
, callback requested, not interested, etc.)

Following a structured follow-up cadence for businesses that don't answer the first time (we'll provide the exact cadence)

Immediately and permanently removing anyone from the call list who asks not to be contacted again

Occasionally scheduling a discovery call directly onto our calendar when a business owner is interested



What We're Looking For



Fluent, clear spoken English — you'll be representing our company directly to business owners

Prior cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment-setting experience preferred, but not required if you're a fast learner and comfortable on the phone

Comfortable with rejection — most calls won't lead anywhere, and that's normal, not a reflection of your performance

Reliable internet connection and a quiet space to make calls

Organized — you'll be expected to keep accurate records of every call



What We're NOT Looking For



No autodialers, robo-dialing tools, or mass-texting software — every call is a real, live, one-on-one conversation

No high-pressure, scripted "always be closing" sales tactics — we want a genuine, low-pressure conversation, not a pitch that feels pushy



Compensation & Growth



Starting hourly rate based on experience, paid on a schedule we'll agree on directly (no OnlineJobs.ph markup)

Performance bonus or sales commission structure available once we see call volume and success rate over the first few weeks

Real potential to move to full-time hours as our business grows, plus first consideration for future roles as we build out our team

You’ll also handle short-form repurposing and course editing, and work daily alongside our Content & Community lead. You need to have a good understanding of hooks, shortform vs long form and retention strategies to keep the viewer hooked. 



Why this role is different:

This is a rare seat: a small, fast-paced team working shoulder-to-shoulder with a creator with 1.9M+ followers across platforms — full-time, not freelance-in-a-queue, not one of fifty editors on an agency roster. You’ll be inside the business as it happens: filming before it’s public, strategy before the data confirms it, and the real build of The Future Creator as it goes from audit launch this year to a signature course in 2027. Few editors ever get this close to the whole picture, or this much ownership over shaping it. You will see the behind the scenes of big product launches and work with a team to bring a vision to life.



Who this is a good fit for

You’ll thrive here if you:

 • Love learning and want a role that keeps teaching you, access to exclusive course material to level up your skillset

 • Edit YouTube long-form (20–30 min): vlogs, GRWMs, tutorials, Q&As — pacing, comedic timing, retention-built cuts

What we’re looking for

 • 3+ years editing for creators experience non-negotiable

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
About the role



Zac King Productions (ZKP) is a done-for-you video production and performance

marketing agency working exclusively with buyers agents and mortgage brokers

across Australia. We build VSL funnels, Meta ad campaigns, and GHL

automation for our clients. Our core product is a 90-day paid ads sprint

with a performance guarantee (15 qualified shows in 90 days or we work for

free).



We're moving to an ads-first model. This role sits at the centre of that.

You'll be writing the scripts and copy that go straight into a client's ad

campaign and directly influence whether we hit that guarantee.



This is a fully remote role. Async-first, Slack-based team, weekly video

huddle.



The mission of this seat:



Every VSL, ad script, and pre-call script for every active sprint client is

written, internally reviewed, and delivered to the client with enough lead

time for a proper review before the shoot. Every time, on schedule.



**The number you own:** scripts delivered vs due, and days from brief to

client-approved. We care more about the second number than the first.

Writing fast means nothing if the client doesn't get a real chance to

review before we're on set.



What you'll actually be doing



- Writing VSL scripts, ad scripts (multiple hooks per client), and pre-call

  scripts for every new client entering our 90-day sprint

- Writing organic content scripts for our existing retainer clients

  (talking points, story-driven scripts, YouTube scripts depending on the

  client) as we wind that side of the business down over time

- Writing funnel copy: landing pages,
 and SMS nurture sequences, for

  GHL builds

- Working from our existing frameworks: HAIL (Hook, Anchor, Illustrate,

  Lesson) for scripts, and CCN (Core, Casual, New) for topic validation

- Working from ICP avatars already built per client (Hopes, Dreams, Fears,

  Blockers). You won't be building these from scratch every time, but

  you'll need to understand and apply them

- Delivering scripts to internal review 2 business days before the client

  deadline, every time. This is a hard internal SLA, not a suggestion

- Working closely with our production lead and videographer to make sure

  scripts translate cleanly into shot lists and are locked well ahead of

  filming

- Occasionally writing static ad copy (headline, primary text, overlay) as

  we roll out static ad creative alongside video



What this role is NOT



- You are not chasing clients for script approval. That's the production

  lead's job once your copy is delivered

- You are not building shot lists. That's the videographer's job, working

  from your approved script

- You are not doing GHL implementation. You write the copy, someone else

  builds the funnel

- You are not managing client relationships day to day



Who we're looking for



**Must-haves:**

- Experience writing for real estate, property investment, or finance,

  specifically. You understand the buyer psychology in a considered

  purchase category, not just general direct response

- Direct response copywriting experience. You understand hooks, pattern

  interrupts, and why "12 to 19 kilos" beats "lose weight"

- Comfortable writing to a 5th-grade reading level on command. Short

  sentences, short paragraphs, no fluff, no corporate speak

- Experience writing video scripts specifically, not just static copy. You

  understand pacing, how something sounds out loud vs how it reads

- Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality. This role runs on tight,

  real deadlines tied to shoot dates that can't move

- You can use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up research, first

  drafts, and idea generation, but every script that leaves your hands is

  written in your voice, checked against the brief, and edited by you

  before it's submitted. We can tell the difference between a script

  that's been genuinely crafted and one that's been pasted straight out of

  a chat window, and the second one doesn't get through review. If you

  lean on AI to think for you rather than to work faster, this isn't the

  role for you

- Strong written English. Australian idiom and tone is a plus, but clear,

  natural, non-robotic writing matters more than nationality



**Nice-to-haves:**

- Experience with GHL, ClickFunnels, or similar funnel builders. You won't

  build funnels, but understanding how copy sits inside one helps

- Familiarity with the CLOSER sales framework or similar direct response

  sales methodology



**A note on repetition:** you'll be writing for a narrow niche, buyers

agents and mortgage brokers, across a rotating roster of individual

clients. Each client has a different story, avatar, and offer, but the

industry stays constant. If you need constant category-switching to stay

engaged, this isn't the role for you. If you enjoy going deep on one niche

and getting genuinely good at it, this is exactly that kind of role.



How we work



- Scripts are drafted in Google Docs, moved to our project tracker once a

  client approves

- You'll get a locked deadline for every deliverable. Internal deadline

  is always 2 business days ahead of the client-facing deadline, no

  exceptions

- All scripts follow set structures (HAIL for video, defined templates for

  funnel copy). We're not looking for someone to reinvent our frameworks,

  we're looking for someone who can execute inside them at speed

- Direct, specific feedback is part of the culture here. We'll tell you

  plainly what's not working and why, and we expect the same directness

  back if a brief is unclear or a deadline is unrealistic



Application process



1. Send a Loom video (5 minutes max) walking through one direct response

   script you've written. What the brief was, what you d
, why

2. Include 2–3 writing samples (scripts preferred over static copy, but

   either is fine)

3. If shortlisted, a paid test task: one short VSL script written against

   a real (anonymised) ZKP client brief, turned around in 48 hours



No cover letters. We'd rather see your work than read about it.



Compensation

This role pays between $1000 - $3000 AUD per month

description:

- Neutralize and correct a bad existing color grade on final exported footage

- Restore natural, accurate color throughout the entire clip including skin tones, environment, and overall warmth

- Match color consistency across multiple clips from the same shoot

- Deliver clean results without introducing banding, noise, or artifacts



Requirements:



- Experience with color correction work on final exported files, not RAW footage

- You may use whatever software or tools you prefer as long as the final deliverable is high quality and color accurate

This is NOT a fit if:



- You are a general social media video editor with no dedicated color work experience

A 2-3 minute Loom video introducing yourself. Tell me something about you — a personal hobby, interest, or fun fact about you (I'd like to get to know you as a person too! ?? ) What drew you to color work, and what limitations if any exist when working with final exported files and how do you work within them?



2-3 before/after examples of color correction work

description:
Google Local Service Ads QA/QC Representative



We are a group of fast-growing, U.S.-based marketing agencies helping honest, hardworking local service businesses grow through effective digital marketing. Our brands include Honest Mechanic Marketing, Honest Roofer Marketing, and DTL Consultants.



We work primarily with automotive repair shops (70%), roofing companies, and other local service businesses. Our mission is simple: help good businesses get better leads, better tracking, and better results without fluff or false promises.



We are looking for a detail-oriented Google Local Service Ads QA/QC Representative to join our remote team. This role is focused on reviewing phone calls generated from Google Local Service Ads, documenting lead quality, adding notes inside Google, and preparing clear reports for our Client Services team.



This is a great role for someone who is organized, consistent, comfortable listening to U.S.-based phone calls, and able to identify whether a call was a good lead, bad lead, missed opportunity, spam, wrong service, or other issue.



Role Overview:

The Google LSA QA/QC Representative will be responsible for reviewing call recordings from Google Local Service Ads accounts across multiple clients. You will listen to calls, evaluate the quality of each lead, add accurate notes into the Google LSA platform, and update internal reports so our Client Services team can communicate clearly with clients.



This role requires strong English comprehension, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to follow a consistent review process.



Key Responsibilities:

Provide weekly call review summaries for the Client Services team.

Follow internal QA/QC standards to ensure calls are reviewed consistently and accurately.



What You Will Be Reviewing:

Was this a real customer looking for service?

Was the call answered professionally?

Did the client miss the call?

Was the caller trying to book an appointment?

title: Real Estate Data Manager (List Management & Duplicate Prevention Systems)
description:
We are a land investing company looking for an experienced Data Manager to build a clean, organized system for managing our property data.



This is not a basic data entry role.



We pull property records, skip trace them, and market directly to sellers. Our biggest bottleneck right now is data management. We need a system that ensures we are not pulling or paying for the same data more than once.



Our goal is to eliminate wasted spend from duplicate and repeated data pulls.



We currently pull property data using Land Portal, Land Insights, and Land Vision software, so experience working with exported property or parcel datasets (CSV/Excel) is important.



We are looking for someone who can build a simple, effective system to manage and prevent duplicate property data at scale.



Responsibilities:

Review and organize our existing Google Sheets data

Build a master database of all property records we’ve pulled

Create a system to remove duplicate records and prevent us from repulling the same properties in the future

Set up a process to compare new lists against existing data before skip tracing

Structure and tag data (date pulled, skip traced, follow-up timelines, etc.)

Create a clear, repeatable workflow (SOP) for pulling, cleaning, and preparing data

Recommend improvements to make the system more efficient and cost-effective

Requirements:

Advanced experience with Google Sheets or Excel

Experience working with real estate or property data (land is a strong plus)

Strong understanding of removing duplicate records and preventing repeated data pulls over time

Familiarity with parcel-level data (APN, owner records, etc.)

Ability to build simple, scalable systems

Clear communication and ability to explain your process step-by-step

Build and implement a process within our data software (Land Portal) to prevent exporting duplicate property records, including creating and maintaining suppression lists to filter out previously pulled data

Project Scope:



Important:



This role is focused on building a system that prevents duplicate data from ever being used.



This includes:



Preventing repurchasing the same property records more than once

Preventing duplicate skip tracing on records already processed

Structuring data so new lists are checked against existing records BEFORE any skip tracing or processing happens

We  want to implement a system that prevents pulling duplicate records directly within our data software (Land Portal) before export, using suppression lists or similar tools. The goal is to eliminate duplicates at the source and create a simple, repeatable process that can be followed every time new data is pulled.





This is not just about cleaning data — it’s about building a system that eliminates unnecessary spend and ensures we only work with new, unused records.



This is a project-based role to build out our data system using our current datasets.



If the system works well, there will be ongoing work to manage and maintain it.



How to Apply:



Please answer the questions below in detail:



1. Walk me through a system you’ve built to manage large datasets. How was it structured and how was it used day-to-day?

2. Explain how you would make sure we never pull or skip trace the same property twice, even months later. What fields or identifiers would you use?

3. If you were given multiple property lists pulled at different times, how would you combine them into one clean master database?

4. How would you track when data should be reused or repulled (ex: 3 months, 6 months, 12 months)?

5. What tools, formulas, or methods do you use in Google Sheets or Excel to clean and organize data efficiently?



Compensation:

Please include your fixed price for completing this project and briefly outline what deliverables you would provide (for example: master sheet, duplicate filtering system, SOP/process, etc.).

title: SEO & Discoverability Specialist

title: Property Manager / Assisstant
description:
Property Management Assistant (Virtual) — U.S. Real Estate Rental Portfolio



Company: Alpha Cash Buyers / ACB Properties (Dallas–Fort Worth, TX)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Type: Long-term, 30–40 hours/week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, U.S. Central business hours (night shift in the Philippines — see below)

Pay: $6/hour to start ? $7/hour after 60–90 day ramp





About Us



We're a U.S.-based real estate investment company in the Dallas–Fort Worth area. Alongside our acquisitions business, we own and manage a growing portfolio of single-family rental homes. This role is on the property management side — keeping our rentals running smoothly so the owner can focus on growth.



This is a long-term role built on trust and ownership. We want someone who takes the rental operation off our plate, not someone we have to check on constantly. If you do great work, you grow with us.



What You'll Do



Your job is to keep our rentals organized, our tenants taken care of, and our owner informed. Day to day, that means:



Rent & Payments





Track monthly rent payments and flag anything late or missing

Send rent reminders and follow up on delinquencies

Keep an accurate, up-to-date payment ledger

Reconcile payments and prepare simple monthly summaries





Work Orders & Maintenance





Receive maintenance requests from tenants and log them

Coordinate and schedule with our vendors and contractors (U.S.-based)

Follow each work order through to completion — confirm the job is done and the tenant is satisfied

Keep a clear record of every request, cost, and status





Tenant Communication





Be the first point of contact for tenant questions via text,
, and occasional calls

Respond promptly, professionally, and warmly — you represent us to our tenants

Handle lease questions, move-in/move-out coordination, and renewals





Leasing & Admin





Prepare and organize lease documents, notices, and renewals

Keep property and tenant files complete and up to date

Track key dates (lease expirations, renewals, inspections)

Maintain our property management system and CRM records





General Support (as needed)





Light executive/admin support for the owner —
, calendar, research, data entry, and one-off tasks that come up





What We're Looking For





Excellent written and spoken English — you'll be talking to U.S. tenants and vendors directly

2+ years of property management or real estate VA experience (U.S. rentals strongly preferred)

Hands-on experience with DoorLoop — our property management software. Strong experience with a comparable platform (AppFolio, Buildium, RentManager) plus the ability to get up to speed on DoorLoop quickly will also be considered.

Highly organized and detail-obsessed — nothing falls through the cracks on your watch

Proactive and reliable — you follow through and communicate without being chased

Comfortable working U.S. Central business hours (a night shift in the Philippines — please only apply if this works for you long-term)

A stable internet connection, a backup, and a quiet place to take calls





Bonus points if you have:





Experience with Salesforce

Experience working directly with a U.S. real estate investor or wholesaler

Basic bookkeeping/QuickBooks familiarity





Hours



Monday–Friday, U.S. Central Time — matching our own working hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CT). Two options depending on the fit:





Part-time (30 hrs/week): 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM Central = 10:00 PM – 4:00 AM Manila

Full-time (40 hrs/week): 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Central = 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM Manila (with a 1-hour break)





We'll start you part-time and move to full-time as the role ramps up. This is a night shift in the Philippines — we want to be upfront about that so you can d
 if it fits your life. (Note: U.S. hours shift by one hour twice a year with daylight saving time.)



Compensation





$6.00/hour to start, moving to $7.00/hour after a successful 60–90 day period

Paid bi-weekly, on time, every time

Raises reviewed annually based on your performance





How to Apply



We read every application. To show us you read this whole post:



Start your message with the subject line: "Rentals Off My Plate — [your years of property management experience]"

In the first line, tell us which property management software you've used and for how long.

Then tell us briefly: What's the most stressful tenant or maintenance situation you've handled, and how did you resolve it?

Attach a screenshot of your internet speed (a speed test from speedtest.net works) and a photo of your home office / workspace.

Attach your resume.







Applications that don't follow these steps won't be considered — attention to detail is the whole job.



We respond to strong applicants within 48 hours. We're looking for a long-term teammate, so if that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Legal Billing Assistant
description:
Job Type: Full-time

We are a busy U.S.-based family law firm seeking a Legal Billing Specialist to own our billing, trust accounting, and collections operations. This position requires strong organizational skills, excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to manage sensitive client billing conversations while partnering with attorneys to keep billing accurate and on schedule.

REQUIREMENTS (MANDATORY - NO EXCEPTIONS)

Applicants must meet ALL of the following:



Fluent spoken and written English with a clear American accent

Strong grammar and writing proficiency

Minimum 2 years of legal billing experience, preferably in family law or a similarly complex practice area

Strong understanding of IOLTA trust accounting rules and compliance requirements

Strong Microsoft Excel proficiency, including formulas, pivot tables, and reconciliation work (this will be tested)

Working knowledge of basic accounting and bookkeeping principles such as debits and credits, accounts receivable, and account reconciliation

Experience using legal practice management software such as MyCase, Clio, or Lawmatics

Proficiency managing WIP, invoicing, trust fund applications, and billing reports

Ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



Computer with at least 8GB RAM (16GB preferred)

Stable internet connection (minimum 100 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload) with backup internet access in case of outages

USB headset with clear microphone, since this role handles daily client calls

Dual monitor setup preferred for cross-referencing time entries, invoices, and reports

Quiet, distraction-free home office

Availability to work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central Time (U.S.)



Applicants who do not meet these requirements will not be considered.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Trust and Retainer Management



Monitor client trust balances daily and flag accounts below the minimum retainer threshold

Send timely replenishment requests and follow up to ensure funds are received before work continues

Apply trust funds correctly and maintain IOLTA compliance at all times

Maintain accurate records of all trust transactions and payment activity



Billing and Invoicing



Review and audit attorney and paralegal time entries for accuracy and completeness before billing

Generate pre-bills, final invoices, and monthly review letters

Ensure billing descriptions clearly communicate the value of work performed

Manage work-in-progress and coordinate with attorneys on billing cycles

Run billing reports and provide regular summaries to management



Collections and AR Management



Follow up on past-due balances in a professional and non-confrontational manner

Set up and monitor client payment plans and escalate accounts that are not progressing

Partner with attorneys on client calls when billing issues require legal explanation

Initiate disengagement processes when appropriate and directed

Maintain accurate accounts receivable records and prepare write-off requests for management approval



Client Communication



Handle a minimum of 10 client calls daily (collections, billing inquiries, new client setup)

Communicate clearly regarding balances, statements, and payment options

Respond promptly and professionally, de-escalating concerns when needed

Ensure alignment with the legal team on all billing communications



System and Process Support



Maintain and update client billing records in the firm's practice management software

Assist in identifying and implementing process improvements to billing workflows

Support onboarding of new clients by setting up billing profiles and retainer agreements



PREFERRED



Collections and payment plan management experience in a legal setting

Familiarity with U.S. family law billing practices, retainer structures, and court fee schedules



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS!!!

Interested applicants must send a GOOGLE DRIVE link containing the following:



Your updated resume

A 1-2 minute VIDEO recording introducing yourself, demonstrating your spoken English, and explaining why you are a good fit for the role (set to "Anyone with the link can view")

title: IP, Copyright, Trademark & Public Domain Research Specialist
description:
We are an asset-light IP holding and brand licensing platform modeled on enterprise brand managers like Authentic Brands Group and Disney. We acquire, transform, and protect high-equity trademarks and public domain assets, licensing them out to best-in-class operators while retaining 100% ownership of the core IP. We operate entirely in text, code, and legal frameworks—we own the asset, the licensee owns the overhead.



The Role

We are seeking a brilliant, highly meticulous IP, Copyright & Public Domain Research Specialist to act as the internal human layer for our forensic asset research. In this role, you will be 100% focused on legal data, clearance, and asset tracking. You will utilize Google Gemini alongside official databases to clear trademarks, register copyrights, map out the entry of legacy works into the public domain, and build institutional background dossiers on distressed brands targeted for acquisition.



Daily Responsibilities

US Copyright Execution: Prepare and systematically file official US copyright applications for all original Ventured materials, layout structures, and transformed derivative works.



USPTO Forensic Research: Actively monitor the USPTO database to isolate dead, cancelled, or lapsed zombie brands (specifically tracking Section 8/9 renewal failures) matching our target lifestyle and consumer criteria.



Acquisition Fact-Checking & Dossier Building: Conduct exhaustive background research on potential brand acquisitions, compiling comprehensive dossiers for executive review that break down financial health, past operational scale, corporate history, and brand narratives.



Public Domain Timeline Mapping: Audit and project the exact years legacy creative works, literature, characters, and assets will enter the public domain under US law, flagging high-commercial-value opportunities for our revival pipeline.

Data & Vault Organization: Maintain pristine, hyper-organized tracking systems within Google Docs and Google Sheets, documenting all active filings, renewal timelines, and pre-vetted brand data.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

title: Government Contracts & Proposal Coordinator
description:
1.1 Mission

The Coordinator's mission: never miss a deadline, never submit an incomplete proposal, never lose a contract to paperwork, and maintain 100% compliance — while building a repeatable bidding machine that scales with the company.

The Coordinator is the air-traffic controller of every pursuit. Estimators price the work; project teams build it; leadership sets strategy. The Coordinator makes sure that every opportunity is found, qualified, assembled, compliance-checked, and submitted on time, complete, and correct — every single time.



1.2 Purpose of the Role

Government work is won or lost on discipline. A brilliant price on an incomplete package loses. A perfect technical proposal submitted one minute late loses. A missing certification voids an award. The Coordinator exists to remove those failure modes permanently by operating the systems in this manual.

? Find and track every relevant opportunity across all portals.

? Qualify opportunities with a disciplined Go/No-Go process before we spend estimating hours.

? Assemble complete, compliant bid packages using standardized checklists.

? Coordinate estimators, subcontractors, and suppliers so information arrives on time.

? Run quality assurance so no proposal leaves the building with an error.

? Submit flawlessly, capture confirmations, and archive everything.

? Manage post-award compliance setup so we start projects clean.

? Maintain the document library, databases, and compliance calendar as living systems.



Daily, Weekly, Monthly & Annual Responsibilities



The role runs on rhythm. These checklists convert the mission into repeatable habits.



2.1 Morning Checklist (first 90 minutes)

?  Review the Deadline Tracker; confirm every open bid's due date, time, and time zone.

?  Check all portal notifications (
, NJSTART, BidNet Direct, PennBid, county/municipal, school, housing authority) for new opportunities and, critically, new addenda/amendments.

?  Log any new addenda in the Addenda Log for every active pursuit and flag scope/price impacts to the estimator.

?  Scan
 for subcontractor/supplier quotes, RFI responses, and agency communications; file and log each.

?  Update the Opportunity Tracker status for anything that changed overnight.

?  Identify today's single most important deadline and block time to protect it.

?  Raise any red flags (missing bond, expiring insurance, unclear spec) to your manager before 10:00 a.m.



2.2 Afternoon Checklist



?  Advance the top-priority bid package: assemble documents, request missing items, update the checklist.

?  Follow up on outstanding subcontractor/supplier quotes and RFIs with a written, logged request.

?  Verify that any addenda received today are incorporated into the estimate and the package.

?  Confirm bonding and insurance are in motion for bids due within 7 days.

?  Update the Question Log; submit any pre-bid questions well before the solicitation's question deadline.

?  Perform a mid-stage QA pass on any package reaching 75% completion.



2.3 End-of-Day Checklist



?  Reconcile the Deadline Tracker: every active bid has an accurate status and next action.

?  Confirm nothing due tomorrow is incomplete; if it is, escalate tonight — not tomorrow.

?  Save and version all working files; sync SharePoint/OneDrive.

?  Write a two-line end-of-day status for your manager: what advanced, what is blocked.

?  Set tomorrow's top three priorities.



2.4 Weekly Responsibilities



?  Run saved searches across all portals and refresh the pipeline; add new qualified opportunities.

?  Hold a bid-review huddle with estimating: priorities, due dates, resource conflicts.

?  Audit the document library for anything expiring in the next 45 days.

?  Update the KPI dashboard (opportunities reviewed, packages in progress, submissions).

?  Reconcile subcontractor/supplier database additions and note coverage gaps by trade and region.

?  Back up all active bid folders and confirm version control is clean.



2.5 Monthly Responsibilities



?  Full document-library expiration audit (insurance, bonds capacity, registrations, licenses, certifications).

?  Pipeline review with leadership: win rate, hit rate, revenue-weighted pipeline, capacity.

?  Post-bid debrief roll-up: wins, losses, pricing gaps, lessons learned.

?  Verify 
 registration status and renewal timeline; confirm UEI/CAGE active.

?  Refresh saved searches and NAICS coverage; prune dead portals, add new ones.

?  Update templates and this manual with any process improvements approved during the month.



2.6 Quarterly Responsibilities



?  Comprehensive compliance self-audit.

?  Bonding capacity review with the surety/broker; update aggregate and single-job limits.

?  Insurance program review with the broker; confirm limits meet target agencies' requirements.

?  Subcontractor prequalification refresh cycle; re-collect expiring COIs and certifications.

?  KPI trend review and goal reset for the next quarter.

?  Portal registration renewals check (state/county/municipal vendor registrations).



2.7 Annual Responsibilities



?  
 annual renewal (do not let it lapse — an expired registration blocks federal awards).

?  State business registration renewals (NJ, PA, MA) and Public Works Contractor Registration where required.

?  Full document library rebuild/verification and archive of prior-year bids per retention policy.

title: HubSpot Solutions Architect

~ Experience leading technical discovery sessions and translating business requirements into scalable platform designs.

~ Experience leading cross-functional project teams across consulting, implementation, and development.

~ Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, SAP, or other enterprise CRM/ERP platforms.

~ Knowledge of iPaaS platforms such as Make, Zapier, Workato, or MuleSoft.

~ Experience designing enterprise reporting and business intelligence solutions.

~ Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and solution governance frameworks.

~ Experience supporting global or multi-business-unit HubSpot implementations.

description:

mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

- Company Introduction Video:



- Company
 Page:

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

s or

description:

You are NOT just a task-taker. You're a systems thinker. You notice what's missing, you follow up without being asked, and you don't let things fall through the cracks. You're the person who reads a messy brain dump and turns it into a clean, organized plan.

You also work well with a creative, fast-moving founder who has a lot of ideas — and you know how to keep things on track without slowing things down.

Oversee and document backend systems (Zapier, Kit/ConvertKit, membership platform, website)

Map funnels — what connects to what, where links go, what's working

Keep projects and tasks organized across the team

Potentially manage and coordinate with one other VA





Skills and Tools

Required:



Zapier

Kit / ConvertKit

ManyChat

Metricool

 and Instagram

Numbers (Apple)

Organized AF — we don't care what tool you use, just that nothing slips



Bonus / Growth:



Basic video editing, compressing and uploading

Canva

TikTok and YouTube (basic platform understanding)





You're a Great Fit If:



You are hyper-detail oriented — nothing slips past you

You're proactive, not reactive

You can manage up — meaning you'll follow up with me if needed

You communicate clearly and consistently





This Is Not a Fit If:



You need constant direction to stay on task

You disappear when things get quiet

You say yes to everything and follow through on nothing





Pay and Hours

How you use AI in your work (if you do) and where you draw the line

Why this role interests you



Applications without a video will not be considered.



Looking forward to meeting you,

Jillian H.

title: Experienced Canva Workbook Designer & Digital Product VA | Long-Term Position*

* Special education resources

* Intervention systems

* Advanced Canva skills.

* Experience creating professional multi-page workbooks, eBooks, guides, or digital products.

* Strong English reading comprehension.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong proofreading and quality-control skills.

* The ability to follow detailed written instructions.

* Experience working with large documents of 50+ pages.

* Reliable internet access.

* Consistent weekly availability.

* Strong communication skills.

* The ability to work independently without constant supervision.

.

* Professional

* Premium

* Modern

* Visually engaging

* Appropriate for educators and school administrators

* Quality

* Reliability

* Productivity

* Communication

* Ability to meet deadlines



Applicants must be able to maintain a consistent weekly work schedule.



Compensation

**$4.00 USD per hour to start.**



There is potential for:

* Long-term employment

* Expanded responsibilities



for tea
mbers who consistently demonstrate exceptional quality, reliability, and efficiency.
